quote: Diagnostic assays for CaHV detection were reported, such as multiplex polymerase chain reaction (PCR), paraffin section assay (Fang et al., 2016) and real-time PCR (Li et al., 2019 ; Zhao et al., 2020).
statement: 已报道用于检测CaHV的诊断方法，如多重聚合酶链反应（PCR）、石蜡切片检测和实时荧光定量PCR。
text_zh: 已报道用于检测CaHV的诊断方法，如多重聚合酶链反应（PCR）、石蜡切片检测和实时荧光定量PCR。
text_en: Diagnostic methods reported for detecting CaHV include multiplex polymerase chain reaction (PCR), paraffin section assay, and real-time fluorescent quantitative PCR.
intervention: Multiplex PCR, paraffin section and real-time PCR

quote: Recombinase-aid amplification (RAA) has been a novel isothermal nucleic acid rapid amplification technology in recent years for aquatic diseases pathogen detection, such as IHNV (Chen et al., 2020), CyHV-2 (Preena et al., 2022), GCRV (Wang et al., 2020).
statement: 重组酶辅助扩增（RAA）是近年来用于水生动物病原体检测的一种新型等温核酸快速扩增技术。
text_zh: 重组酶辅助扩增（RAA）是近年来用于水生动物病原体检测的一种新型等温核酸快速扩增技术。
text_en: Recombinase-aided amplification (RAA) is a novel isothermal nucleic acid rapid amplification technology used in recent years for the detection of aquatic animal pathogens.

quote: With the gradual development of intensive aquaculture, fish farming is facing many disease problems (2), such as Rahnella aquatilis (3), Edwardsiella ictaluri (4), Aeromonas hydrophila (5), which has caused huge economic losses to the breeding industry.
statement: 集约化养殖的发展导致鱼类面临多种疾病问题，造成巨大的经济损失。
text_zh: 集约化养殖的发展导致鱼类面临多种疾病问题，造成巨大的经济损失。
text_en: The development of intensive farming has led to various disease problems in fish, causing huge economic losses.

quote: Due to the lack of fish vaccines, antibiotic treatment has become a common way to fight bacterial infections.
statement: 由于缺乏鱼用疫苗，抗生素治疗已成为对抗细菌感染的一种常见方式。
text_zh: 由于缺乏鱼用疫苗，抗生素治疗已成为对抗细菌感染的一种常见方式。
text_en: Due to the lack of fish vaccines, antibiotic treatment has become a common way to combat bacterial infections.

quote: The fish in each subgroup were kept in a fiberglass tank (about 500 L) with constant aeration.
statement: 实验中的鱼被饲养在约500升的玻璃钢水箱中，并持续充氧。
text_zh: 实验中的鱼被饲养在约500升的玻璃钢水箱中，并持续充氧。
text_en: The fish in the experiment were kept in approximately 500-liter fiberglass-reinforced plastic tanks with continuous aeration.

quote: The water temperature was maintained at 28°C with a heating rod.
statement: 水温通过加热棒维持在28°C。
text_zh: 水温通过加热棒维持在28°C。
text_en: Water temperature was maintained at 28°C using a heating rod.

quote: During the whole experiment, the pH of the water was 7.1–7.5
statement: 在整个实验期间，水的pH值保持在7.1至7.5之间。
text_zh: 在整个实验期间，水的pH值保持在7.1至7.5之间。
text_en: Throughout the entire experiment, the water pH was maintained between 7.1 and 7.5.

quote: Following each dose administration, the treated fish were observed in a fresh tank for 5 min for possible regurgitation of ENR.
statement: 每次给药后，将处理过的鱼在新鲜水箱中观察5分钟，以检查是否发生恩诺沙星反流。
text_zh: 每次给药后，将处理过的鱼在新鲜水箱中观察5分钟，以检查是否发生恩诺沙星反流。
text_en: After each administration, the treated fish were observed in fresh water tanks for 5 minutes to check for enrofloxacin regurgitation.

quote: After drug administration, six fish of one subgroup were randomly sacrificed by a blow to the head and sampled at each time point.
statement: 给药后，随机选取一个亚组的六条鱼通过头部击打处死并在每个时间点采样。
text_zh: 给药后，随机选取一个亚组的六条鱼通过头部击打处死并在每个时间点采样。
text_en: After administration, six fish from a randomly selected subgroup were euthanized by percussive stunning and sampled at each time point.

quote: Conventional PCR was carried out using PCR-F/R primers specific for TNFR gene of CaHV with product sizes of 789 bp (in Table.1).
statement: 使用针对CaHV的TNFR基因的特异性引物PCR-F/R进行常规PCR，产物大小为789 bp。
text_zh: 使用针对CaHV的TNFR基因的特异性引物PCR-F/R进行常规PCR，产物大小为789 bp。
text_en: Conventional PCR was performed using specific primers PCR-F/R targeting the TNFR gene of CaHV, with a product size of 789 bp.

population.species: CaHV宿主（未明确具体养殖动物种类，但涉及病毒检测）

quote: RAA-LFD assay was performed to detect CaHV and the other fish viruses including CyHV-2, KHV, IHNV, SVCV and GCRV under the optimized conditions.
statement: 在优化条件下，使用RAA-LFD检测方法检测CaHV以及其他鱼类病毒，包括CyHV-2、KHV、IHNV、SVCV和GCRV。
text_zh: 在优化条件下，使用RAA-LFD检测方法检测CaHV以及其他鱼类病毒，包括CyHV-2、KHV、IHNV、SVCV和GCRV。
text_en: Under optimized conditions, the RAA-LFD detection method was used to detect CaHV and other fish viruses, including CyHV-2, KHV, IHNV, SVCV and GCRV.
outcome: 多种鱼类病毒的鉴别诊断

quote: CaHV is a fatal pathogen of crucian carp, which can cause 100% mortality within one week (Zhang and Gui, 2018 ; Gui and Zhang, 2019).
statement: CaHV是鲫鱼的致命病原体，可在一周内导致100%的死亡率。
text_zh: CaHV是鲫鱼的致命病原体，可在一周内导致100%的死亡率。
text_en: CaHV is a lethal pathogen of crucian carp, capable of causing 100% mortality within one week.

quote: Several specific and sensitive methods have been developed for detection of viruses in fish, such as reverse transcription (RT)-PCR, nested PCR test, real-time PCR (qPCR), reverse-transcriptase real-time PCR (RT-rPCR) and reverse-transcriptase droplet digital PCR (RT-ddPCR) (Gilad et al., 2004 ; El-Matbouli et al., 2007 ; Sadler et al., 2008 ; Honjo et al., 2010 ; Yuasa et al., 2012 ; Purcell et al., 2013 ; Zeng et al., 2014 ; Jia et al., 2017).
statement: 已开发出多种用于检测鱼类病毒的特定且敏感的方法，如RT-PCR、巢式PCR、实时荧光定量PCR等。
text_zh: 已开发出多种用于检测鱼类病毒的特定且敏感的方法，如RT-PCR、巢式PCR、实时荧光定量PCR等。
text_en: Various specific and sensitive methods for detecting fish viruses have been developed, such as RT-PCR, nested PCR, and real-time fluorescent quantitative PCR.

quote: Isothermal amplification technologies, such as RPA/RAA and loop mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) assays, have features of high specificity, rapidity and simplicity of detection of various viruses (Congdon et al., 2019 ; Fan et al., 2020).
statement: 恒温扩增技术（如RPA/RAA和LAMP）具有特异性高、速度快和操作简便的特点，可用于检测各种病毒。
text_zh: 恒温扩增技术（如RPA/RAA和LAMP）具有特异性高、速度快和操作简便的特点，可用于检测各种病毒。
text_en: Isothermal amplification techniques (such as RPA/RAA and LAMP) have the characteristics of high specificity, fast speed, and simple operation, and can be used to detect various viruses.

quote: In comparison between RPA/RAA and LAMP, RPA just demands a single pair of primers and lasts around 30 min, whereas LAMP requires 6 primers and lasts around 60 min, which illustrates that RPA is more convenient and economical than LAMP for aquatic diseases detection (Zhang et al., 2014 ; Lobato and O’Sullivan, 2018 ; Diagne et al., 2020).
statement: 与LAMP相比，RPA仅需一对引物且耗时约30分钟，而LAMP需6种引物且耗时约60分钟，表明在水生疾病检测中RPA比LAMP更便捷和经济。
text_zh: 与LAMP相比，RPA仅需一对引物且耗时约30分钟，而LAMP需6种引物且耗时约60分钟，表明在水生疾病检测中RPA比LAMP更便捷和经济。

quote: It has a good bactericidal effect on most Gram-negative bacteria and some Gram-positive bacteria such as Aeromonas hydrophila (6), Flavobacterium columnare (7), Yersinia ruckeri , and Vibrio anguillarum (8 , 9).
statement: 它对大多数革兰氏阴性菌和一些革兰氏阳性菌（如嗜水气单胞菌、柱状黄杆菌、耶尔森氏菌和鳗弧菌）具有良好的杀菌作用。
text_zh: 它对大多数革兰氏阴性菌和一些革兰氏阳性菌（如嗜水气单胞菌、柱状黄杆菌、耶尔森氏菌和鳗弧菌）具有良好的杀菌作用。
text_en: It has good bactericidal effects against most Gram-negative bacteria and some Gram-positive bacteria (such as Aeromonas hydrophila, Flavobacterium columnare, Yersinia, and Vibrio anguillarum).

quote: Due to its excellent pharmacokinetic properties and broad-spectrum antibacterial activity, ENR is widely used to prevent and treat bacterial infections in aquatic animals.
statement: 由于其优异的药代动力学特性和广谱抗菌活性，恩诺沙星被广泛用于预防和治疗水生动物的细菌感染。
text_zh: 由于其优异的药代动力学特性和广谱抗菌活性，恩诺沙星被广泛用于预防和治疗水生动物的细菌感染。
text_en: Due to its excellent pharmacokinetic properties and broad-spectrum antibacterial activity, enrofloxacin is widely used for the prevention and treatment of bacterial infections in aquatic animals.

quote: For aquatic animals, antibacterial drugs are usually given multiple times in succession to achieve the desired therapeutic effect (22).
statement: 对于水生动物，通常连续多次给予抗菌药物以达到预期的治疗效果。
text_zh: 对于水生动物，通常连续多次给予抗菌药物以达到预期的治疗效果。
text_en: For aquatic animals, antimicrobial drugs are usually administered in multiple consecutive doses to achieve the expected therapeutic effect.

quote: Therefore, RAA-LFD method could be applied for point-of-care testing (POCT) for the early infection prevention and control of CaHV.
statement: 因此，RAA-LFD方法可应用于CaHV早期感染预防和控制中的即时检验（POCT）。
text_zh: 因此，RAA-LFD方法可应用于CaHV早期感染预防和控制中的即时检验（POCT）。
text_en: Therefore, the RAA-LFD method can be applied to point-of-care testing (POCT) in the early infection prevention and control of CaHV.

quote: Based on our previous study of the extraction of DNA from fish skin mucus within 30 seconds with low cost (USD $0.02) (Gui et al., 2022), we established a rapid, sensitive and cheap method to detect CaHV within 35min from sample collection to result interpretation.
statement: 基于我们之前关于从鱼皮肤粘液中提取DNA的研究（30秒内，低成本0.02美元），我们建立了一种快速、灵敏且廉价的CaHV检测方法，从样本采集到结果解读需在35分钟内完成。
text_zh: 基于我们之前关于从鱼皮肤粘液中提取DNA的研究（30秒内，低成本0.02美元），我们建立了一种快速、灵敏且廉价的CaHV检测方法，从样本采集到结果解读需在35分钟内完成。
text_en: Based on our previous research on extracting DNA from fish skin mucus (within 30 seconds, low cost of $0.02), we established a rapid, sensitive, and inexpensive CaHV detection method that requires completion within 35 minutes from sample collection to result interpretation.
intervention_record: 皮肤黏液快速DNA提取检测

quote: Our study could provide a simple, rapid, and low-cost detecting application for POCT in aquaculture industry.
statement: 我们的研究可以为水产养殖业的即时检验提供一种简单、快速和低成本的检测应用。
text_zh: 我们的研究可以为水产养殖业的即时检验提供一种简单、快速和低成本的检测应用。
text_en: Our study can provide a simple, rapid and low-cost detection application for point-of-care testing in the aquaculture industry.
intervention: Detection method established in this study
intervention_record: 本研究建立的检测方法

quote: About 2 ml of blood samples were collected from the caudal vessel by using heparinized syringes, after centrifuging at 2,683 g for 10 min, the plasma was then transferred to another test tube.
statement: 使用肝素化注射器从尾静脉采集约2毫升血液，离心后分离血浆。
text_zh: 使用肝素化注射器从尾静脉采集约2毫升血液，离心后分离血浆。
text_en: Approximately 2 mL of blood was collected from the tail vein using a heparinized syringe, and plasma was separated after centrifugation.

quote: Our RAA-LFD assay showed a comparable limit of detection (100 copies), exhibited by most of the RPA assays developed for fish viruses, such as largemouth bass ranavirus (58.3 copies) (Guo et al., 2022), CyHV-2 (100 copies) (Preena et al., 2022) and Micropterus salmoides rhabdovirus (170 copies) (Feng et al., 2022).
statement: 本研究的RAA-LFD检测显示出与大多数针对鱼类病毒开发的RPA检测相当的检出限（100个拷贝）。
text_zh: 本研究的RAA-LFD检测显示出与大多数针对鱼类病毒开发的RPA检测相当的检出限（100个拷贝）。
text_en: The RAA-LFD detection in this study showed a limit of detection (100 copies) comparable to most RPA assays developed for fish viruses.

quote: Based on the calculated PK/PD indices of C max /MIC and AUC 24h /MIC, the multiple-dosing regimen would have a very good effect on pathogens with a MIC value of <1.84 μg/ml.
statement: 基于计算的PK/PD指数Cmax/MIC和AUC24h/MIC，多次给药方案对MIC值小于1.84 μg/ml的病原体将产生非常好的效果。
text_zh: 基于计算的PK/PD指数Cmax/MIC和AUC24h/MIC，多次给药方案对MIC值小于1.84 μg/ml的病原体将产生非常好的效果。
text_en: Based on the calculated PK/PD indices Cmax/MIC and AUC24h/MIC, multiple-dose regimens will produce very good effects against pathogens with MIC values less than 1.84 μg/ml.

quote: Enrofloxacin MICs against bacterial isolates from aquatic animals were previously reported to be 0.06–0.4 μg/ml for Aeromonas hydrophila , 0.005–1.28 μg/ml for Aeromonas salmonicida , 0.005–0.16 μg/ml for Vibrio salmonicida , and 0.005–0.03 μg/ml for Yersinia ruckeni (6 , 9).
statement: 此前报道了恩诺沙星对水生动物细菌分离株的最小抑菌浓度（MIC）范围。
text_zh: 此前报道了恩诺沙星对水生动物细菌分离株的最小抑菌浓度（MIC）范围。
text_en: The minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) range of enrofloxacin against bacterial isolates from aquatic animals has been previously reported.

population.species: 嗜水气单胞菌、鲑鱼弧菌等宿主的水生动物

quote: With increasing carbonate-alkaline concentrations, hemolytic phospholipids associated with cell apoptosis were significantly upregulated and sphingolipid metabolism related to inflammation was more significantly enriched in triploid crucian carp, indicating that triploid crucian carp exhibited significant sensitivity to high carbonate-saline-alkaline stress and poorer carbonate-saline-alkaline tolerance.
statement: 随着碳酸盐碱性浓度的增加，三倍体鲫鱼的溶血磷脂（与细胞凋亡相关）显著上调，且与炎症相关的鞘脂代谢富集更显著，表明三倍体鲫鱼对高碳酸盐-咸-碱胁迫表现出显著的敏感性以及较差的耐受性。
text_zh: 随着碳酸盐碱性浓度的增加，三倍体鲫鱼的溶血磷脂（与细胞凋亡相关）显著上调，且与炎症相关的鞘脂代谢富集更显著，表明三倍体鲫鱼对高碳酸盐-咸-碱胁迫表现出显著的敏感性以及较差的耐受性。
text_en: As the concentration of carbonate alkalinity increased, lysophospholipids (associated with apoptosis) in triploid crucian carp were significantly upregulated, and sphingolipid metabolism associated with inflammation was more significantly enriched, indicating that triploid crucian carp exhibit significant sensitivity and poor tolerance to high carbonate-saline-alkaline stress.

quote: waters with alkalinity exceeding 15 mmol/L significantly impede the normal growth, development, and reproduction of fish, leading to prolonged states of biological inability to reproduce
statement: 碱度超过15 mmol/L的水体会显著阻碍鱼类的正常生长、发育和繁殖，导致长期的生物无法繁殖状态。
text_zh: 碱度超过15 mmol/L的水体会显著阻碍鱼类的正常生长、发育和繁殖，导致长期的生物无法繁殖状态。
text_en: Water bodies with alkalinity exceeding 15 mmol/L significantly hinder the normal growth, development, and reproduction of fish, leading to a long-term state where organisms are unable to reproduce.

quote: This study was conducted in strict accordance with Heilongjiang River Fisheries Research Institute of CAFS Application for Laboratory Animal Welfare and Ethical review (Figure S4).
statement: 本研究严格按照中国水产科学研究院黑龙江水产研究所实验动物福利与伦理审查申请进行。
text_zh: 本研究严格按照中国水产科学研究院黑龙江水产研究所实验动物福利与伦理审查申请进行。
text_en: This study was conducted strictly in accordance with the application for laboratory animal welfare and ethics review of the Heilongjiang Institute of Aquaculture, Chinese Academy of Fishery Sciences.

quote: In recent years, with the advancement of technology, techniques such as transcriptomics, proteomics, and metabolomics have found widespread application in the study of the stress response, ecotoxicology, and growth and development of aquatic organisms, becoming powerful tools for researching physiological changes and organism metabolism in aquatic life [ 17 , 18 ].
statement: 转录组学、蛋白质组学和代谢组学等技术已广泛应用于水生生物应激反应、生态毒理学以及生长发育的研究中，成为研究生理变化和代谢的有力工具。
text_zh: 转录组学、蛋白质组学和代谢组学等技术已广泛应用于水生生物应激反应、生态毒理学以及生长发育的研究中，成为研究生理变化和代谢的有力工具。
text_en: Techniques such as transcriptomics, proteomics, and metabolomics have been widely applied in research on stress responses, ecotoxicology, and growth and development of aquatic organisms, becoming powerful tools for studying physiological changes and metabolism.
outcome: 应激反应、生理变化及代谢

quote: Metabolomics, being capable of both qualitative and quantitative analysis of small-molecule metabolites within an organism, provides a novel research approach for elucidating the metabolic characteristics and mechanisms of fish under saline-alkaline stress.
statement: 代谢组学能够对生物体内小分子代谢物进行定性和定量分析，为阐明鱼类在盐碱胁迫下的代谢特征和机制提供了新的研究方法。
text_zh: 代谢组学能够对生物体内小分子代谢物进行定性和定量分析，为阐明鱼类在盐碱胁迫下的代谢特征和机制提供了新的研究方法。
text_en: Metabolomics can perform qualitative and quantitative analysis of small molecule metabolites in organisms, providing a new research method for elucidating the metabolic characteristics and mechanisms of fish under saline-alkali stress.
outcome: 盐碱胁迫下的代谢特征与机制

quote: However, crucian carp exhibits relatively strong tolerance in high-concentration saline-alkaline waters compared to other saline-alkaline-tolerant species such as bighead carp (Luciobarbus capito), Darli Lake Waleh Yarrow fish (Leuciscus Waleckii), and naked carp (Kessler) from Qinghai Lake
statement: 与其他耐盐碱物种相比，鲫鱼在高浓度盐碱水中表现出较强的耐受性。
text_zh: 与其他耐盐碱物种相比，鲫鱼在高浓度盐碱水中表现出较强的耐受性。
text_en: Compared with other salt-alkali tolerant species, crucian carp exhibits stronger tolerance in high-concentration salt-alkaline water.

quote: The salinization of the water environment worldwide is increasing, which has brought great challenges to the sustainability of fish farming of aquatic animals.
statement: 全球水环境的盐碱化正在增加，给水产养殖的可持续性带来了巨大挑战。
text_zh: 全球水环境的盐碱化正在增加，给水产养殖的可持续性带来了巨大挑战。
text_en: The salinization of global water environments is increasing, posing a huge challenge to the sustainability of aquaculture.

quote: Three NaHCO 3 concentration groups (0 mmol/L, 20 mmol/L, and 60 mmol/L) were set up in this study to investigate growth and metabolic differences between diploid and triploid crucian carp under saline-alkaline stresses.
statement: 本研究设置了三个NaHCO3浓度组（0 mmol/L、20 mmol/L和60 mmol/L），以研究二倍体和三倍体鲫鱼在盐碱胁迫下的生长和代谢差异。
text_zh: 本研究设置了三个NaHCO3浓度组（0 mmol/L、20 mmol/L和60 mmol/L），以研究二倍体和三倍体鲫鱼在盐碱胁迫下的生长和代谢差异。
text_en: This study set up three NaHCO3 concentration groups (0 mmol/L, 20 mmol/L, and 60 mmol/L) to investigate the differences in growth and metabolism between diploid and triploid crucian carp under saline-alkali stress.

quote: In previous research conducted by our team using non-targeted metabolomics based on Ultra-performance liquid chromatography coupled with quadrupole time-of-flight mass spectrometry (UPLC-QTOF/MS), plasma and gills of the squarehead catfish and bighead carp were studied as target tissues and organs under NaHCO 3 saline-alkaline stress.
statement: 先前的研究利用基于超高效液相色谱-四极杆飞行时间质谱的非靶向代谢组学技术，研究了碳酸氢钠盐碱胁迫下方头鲶和鳙鱼的血浆和鳃。
text_zh: 先前的研究利用基于超高效液相色谱-四极杆飞行时间质谱的非靶向代谢组学技术，研究了碳酸氢钠盐碱胁迫下方头鲶和鳙鱼的血浆和鳃。
text_en: Previous studies used untargeted metabolomics based on ultra-performance liquid chromatography-quadrupole time-of-flight mass spectrometry (UPLC-QTOF/MS) to investigate the plasma and gills of *Pelteobagrus fulvidraco* and *Aristichthys nobilis* under sodium bicarbonate saline-alkali stress.

quote: This research revealed widespread changes in the plasma metabolome under saline-alkaline stress, with cluster analysis indicating alterations in key metabolic pathways related to amino acid synthesis and metabolism, arachidonic acid metabolism, and ketone body metabolism [ 22 , 23 , 24 ].
statement: 该研究揭示了盐碱胁迫下血浆代谢组的广泛变化，聚类分析表明与氨基酸合成及代谢、花生四烯酸代谢和酮体代谢相关的关键代谢途径发生了改变。
text_zh: 该研究揭示了盐碱胁迫下血浆代谢组的广泛变化，聚类分析表明与氨基酸合成及代谢、花生四烯酸代谢和酮体代谢相关的关键代谢途径发生了改变。
text_en: The study revealed widespread changes in the plasma metabolome under saline-alkali stress, and cluster analysis indicated that key metabolic pathways related to amino acid synthesis and metabolism, arachidonic acid metabolism, and ketone body metabolism were altered.

quote: When fish face metabolic disturbances due to external environmental stressors, the metabolites in their blood also undergo changes [ 21 ].
statement: 当鱼类因外部环境压力源面临代谢紊乱时，其血液中的代谢物也会发生变化。
text_zh: 当鱼类因外部环境压力源面临代谢紊乱时，其血液中的代谢物也会发生变化。
text_en: When fish face metabolic disorders due to external environmental stressors, metabolites in their blood also change.

quote: To prevent acute stress reactions in 2n and 3n, the exposure concentrations were gradually increased at a rate of 5 mmol/L per day to reach the required concentration after four days, and then the exposure experiment was started for 30 days.
statement: 为了防止二倍体和三倍体鱼产生急性应激反应，暴露浓度以每天5 mmol/L的速度逐渐增加，四天达到所需浓度后开始为期30天的暴露实验。
text_zh: 为了防止二倍体和三倍体鱼产生急性应激反应，暴露浓度以每天5 mmol/L的速度逐渐增加，四天达到所需浓度后开始为期30天的暴露实验。
text_en: To prevent acute stress responses in diploid and triploid fish, the exposure concentration was gradually increased at a rate of 5 mmol/L per day; after four days to reach the required concentration, a 30-day exposure experiment began.

quote: During the experiment, water was changed every 10 days, with the water replacement volume being one-third of the tank volume.
statement: 实验期间每10天换水一次，换水量为水箱体积的三分之一。
text_zh: 实验期间每10天换水一次，换水量为水箱体积的三分之一。
text_en: During the experiment, water was changed every 10 days, with a replacement volume of one-third of the tank volume.

quote: Sodium bicarbonate was appropriately replenished to maintain the experimental concentrations. Water quality parameters and NaHCO 3 concentrations were monitored throughout the exposure experiment to ensure water stability.
statement: 适当补充碳酸氢钠以维持实验浓度，并监测水质参数和NaHCO3浓度以确保水体稳定。
text_zh: 适当补充碳酸氢钠以维持实验浓度，并监测水质参数和NaHCO3浓度以确保水体稳定。
text_en: Appropriately supplement sodium bicarbonate to maintain the experimental concentration, and monitor water quality parameters and NaHCO3 concentration to ensure water stability.
intervention_record: 补充碳酸氢钠并监测水质

quote: Feeding was halted 24 h before sampling.
statement: 采样前24小时停止喂食。
text_zh: 采样前24小时停止喂食。
text_en: Feeding was stopped 24 hours before sampling.

quote: Fifteen fish were randomly selected from each group and immersed in an anesthetic solution (MS-222) with a concentration of 40 mg/L. After deep anesthesia, 2 mL of blood was collected from the caudal vein.
statement: 从每组随机选取15条鱼浸入40 mg/L的MS-222麻醉溶液中，深度麻醉后从尾静脉采集2 mL血液。
text_zh: 从每组随机选取15条鱼浸入40 mg/L的MS-222麻醉溶液中，深度麻醉后从尾静脉采集2 mL血液。

quote: Previous studies [ 27 ] have indicated that in freshwater aquaculture environments, triploid (3n) individuals exhibit superior traits such as faster growth and stronger stress resistance compared to diploid (2n) individuals.
statement: 先前的研究表明，在淡水养殖环境中，三倍体（3n）个体与二倍体（2n）个体相比表现出更快的生长速度和更强的抗逆性等优良性状。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，在淡水养殖环境中，三倍体（3n）个体与二倍体（2n）个体相比表现出更快的生长速度和更强的抗逆性等优良性状。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that in freshwater aquaculture environments, triploid (3n) individuals exhibit superior traits such as faster growth rates and stronger stress resistance compared to diploid (2n) individuals.
outcome: 生长性能与应激耐受性

quote: However, the differences in stress resistance and growth between 2n and 3n in saline-alkaline water environments are not well understood.
statement: 然而，盐碱水环境中二倍体和三倍体之间在抗逆性和生长方面的差异尚不清楚。
text_zh: 然而，盐碱水环境中二倍体和三倍体之间在抗逆性和生长方面的差异尚不清楚。
text_en: However, the differences in stress resistance and growth between diploid and triploid individuals in saline-alkaline water environments remain unclear.

quote: Simultaneously, at CA20 and CA60 concentrations, Lysophospholipids were significantly upregulated in 3n, indicating more severe destruction of the double-layer structure of the lipid membrane, higher levels of cell death, and subsequent inflammation.
statement: 同时在CA20和CA60浓度下，3倍体的溶血磷脂显著上调，表明脂质膜双层结构破坏更严重、细胞死亡水平更高以及随后的炎症反应。
text_zh: 同时在CA20和CA60浓度下，3倍体的溶血磷脂显著上调，表明脂质膜双层结构破坏更严重、细胞死亡水平更高以及随后的炎症反应。

quote: This reflected 3n’s poorer performance in saline-alkaline stress tolerance compared to 2n.
statement: 这反映了与2倍体相比，3倍体在盐碱胁迫耐受性方面表现较差。
text_zh: 这反映了与2倍体相比，3倍体在盐碱胁迫耐受性方面表现较差。

quote: The metabolomic results indicated that exposure to carbonate-saline-alkaline environments disrupts glycerophospholipid metabolism in the serum of both 2n and 3n individuals, leading to a destabilization of the serum.
statement: Metabolomic results indicate that exposure to carbonate-saline-alkaline environments disrupts glycerophospholipid metabolism in the serum of both diploid (2n) and triploid (3n) individuals, causing serum destabilization.
text_en: Metabolomic results indicate that exposure to carbonate-saline-alkaline environments disrupts glycerophospholipid metabolism in the serum of both diploid (2n) and triploid (3n) individuals, causing serum destabilization.
outcome: 血清稳定性与脂质代谢

quote: Under external environmental stress, excess reactive oxygen species (ROS) bind to unsaturated fatty acids and cholesterol on cell membranes, causing lipid peroxidation, leading to reduced cell membrane fluidity and altered cellular function, which can cause irreversible damage to the organism [ 38 ].
statement: External environmental stress causes excess ROS to bind to membrane components, leading to lipid peroxidation, reduced membrane fluidity, altered cellular function, and potentially irreversible organism damage.
text_en: External environmental stress causes excess ROS to bind to membrane components, leading to lipid peroxidation, reduced membrane fluidity, altered cellular function, and potentially irreversible organism damage.

quote: To further elucidate the metabolic behavior differences between 2n and 3n under saline-alkaline stress, the identified DMs were subjected to metabolic pathway enrichment analysis using MetaboAnalyst 5.0 software
statement: 为了阐明在盐碱胁迫下二倍体（2n）和三倍体（3n）之间的代谢行为差异，对鉴定的差异代谢物进行了代谢通路富集分析。
text_zh: 为了阐明在盐碱胁迫下二倍体（2n）和三倍体（3n）之间的代谢行为差异，对鉴定的差异代谢物进行了代谢通路富集分析。
text_en: To elucidate the differences in metabolic behavior between diploid (2n) and triploid (3n) under salt-alkali stress, pathway enrichment analysis was performed on the identified differential metabolites.

quote: This study provides a preliminary insight into the metabolic differences between 2n and 3n crucian carp at the cellular level under saline-alkaline stress, offering a theoretical foundation for understanding the regulatory mechanisms of 2n and 3n crucian carp in adapting to saline-alkaline environments.
statement: 该研究初步揭示了盐碱胁迫下二倍体和三倍体鲫鱼在细胞水平的代谢差异，为理解二者适应盐碱环境的调控机制提供了理论基础。
text_zh: 该研究初步揭示了盐碱胁迫下二倍体和三倍体鲫鱼在细胞水平的代谢差异，为理解二者适应盐碱环境的调控机制提供了理论基础。
text_en: This study preliminarily revealed the metabolic differences at the cellular level between diploid and triploid crucian carp under saline-alkali stress, providing a theoretical basis for understanding the regulatory mechanisms by which they adapt to saline-alkali environments.

quote: Effects of acute ammonia toxicity on oxidative stress, DNA damage and apoptosis in digestive gland and gill of Asian clam (Corbicula fluminea)
statement: 急性氨氮毒性对亚洲蛤（Corbicula fluminea）消化腺和鳃的氧化应激、DNA损伤及细胞凋亡有影响。
text_zh: 急性氨氮毒性对亚洲蛤（Corbicula fluminea）消化腺和鳃的氧化应激、DNA损伤及细胞凋亡有影响。
text_en: Acute ammonia nitrogen toxicity affects oxidative stress, DNA damage, and apoptosis in the digestive gland and gills of the Asian clam (Corbicula fluminea).
outcome: 氧化应激、DNA损伤及细胞凋亡

quote: Very often, this critical stage of oocyte maturation, relevant to reproductive success, is affected by environmental toxicants acting as hormone mimics, receptor blockers, and/or enzyme inhibitors or other stressful factors, which affect fish breeding in captivity/captive-reared fish
statement: 环境毒素（作为激素模拟物、受体阻断剂或酶抑制剂）和其他压力因素经常影响卵母细胞成熟这一关键阶段，进而影响圈养鱼类的繁殖。
text_zh: 环境毒素（作为激素模拟物、受体阻断剂或酶抑制剂）和其他压力因素经常影响卵母细胞成熟这一关键阶段，进而影响圈养鱼类的繁殖。
text_en: Environmental toxins (as hormone mimics, receptor blockers, or enzyme inhibitors) and other stress factors frequently affect oocyte maturation, a critical stage, thereby affecting the reproduction of captive fish.
outcome: 生殖成功/卵母细胞成熟

quote: To elucidate the metabolic behavioral differences of 2n and 3n under saline-alkaline stress, this study conducted exposure experiments in an indoor NaHCO 3 environment, focusing on metabolic profiling of the serum from 2n and 3n individuals.
statement: 本研究在室内NaHCO3环境中对2倍体和3倍体个体进行了暴露实验，以阐明其在盐碱胁迫下的代谢行为差异。
text_zh: 本研究在室内NaHCO3环境中对2倍体和3倍体个体进行了暴露实验，以阐明其在盐碱胁迫下的代谢行为差异。

quote: This finding suggested that the stress response in terms of metabolic changes was conserved across both 2n and 3n individuals under saline-alkaline exposure.
statement: 这一发现表明，在盐碱暴露下，2倍体和3倍体个体的代谢变化应激反应是保守的（相似的）。
text_zh: 这一发现表明，在盐碱暴露下，2倍体和3倍体个体的代谢变化应激反应是保守的（相似的）。

quote: The fish were separated into eight indoor recirculating aquaculture systems (dimensions: 100 cm × 45 cm × 50 cm) to start to acclimate.
statement: 鱼类被分入八个室内循环水养殖系统（尺寸：100厘米×45厘米×50厘米）开始适应。
text_zh: 鱼类被分入八个室内循环水养殖系统（尺寸：100厘米×45厘米×50厘米）开始适应。
text_en: Fish were placed into eight indoor recirculating aquaculture systems (dimensions: 100 cm × 45 cm × 50 cm) to begin acclimation.

quote: The experimental water was sourced from tap water aerated for 72 h.
statement: 实验用水来源于曝气72小时的自来水。
text_zh: 实验用水来源于曝气72小时的自来水。
text_en: The experimental water was sourced from tap water that had been aerated for 72 hours.

quote: The water temperature was maintained at 24 °C to 26 °C.
statement: 水温维持在24°C至26°C之间。
text_zh: 水温维持在24°C至26°C之间。
text_en: Water temperature was maintained between 24°C and 26°C.

quote: Freshwater control pH was about 7.1, ammonia 7.5 mg/L.
statement: 淡水对照组pH值约为7.1，氨氮浓度为7.5 mg/L。
text_zh: 淡水对照组pH值约为7.1，氨氮浓度为7.5 mg/L。
text_en: The pH of the freshwater control group was about 7.1, and the ammonia nitrogen concentration was 7.5 mg/L.

quote: A 20 mmol/L NaHCO 3 stress group with a pH of about 8.4, ammonia 7.5 mg/L was established.
statement: 建立了20 mmol/L NaHCO3胁迫组，其pH值约为8.4，氨氮浓度为7.5 mg/L。
text_zh: 建立了20 mmol/L NaHCO3胁迫组，其pH值约为8.4，氨氮浓度为7.5 mg/L。
text_en: A 20 mmol/L NaHCO3 stress group was established, with a pH of about 8.4 and an ammonia nitrogen concentration of 7.5 mg/L.

quote: Finally, a 60 mmol/L NaHCO 3 stress group with a pH of about 9.6, ammonia 7.5 mg/L was established.
statement: 最后建立了60 mmol/L NaHCO3胁迫组，其pH值约为9.6，氨氮浓度为7.5 mg/L。
text_zh: 最后建立了60 mmol/L NaHCO3胁迫组，其pH值约为9.6，氨氮浓度为7.5 mg/L。
text_en: Finally, a 60 mmol/L NaHCO3 stress group was established, with a pH of about 9.6 and an ammonia nitrogen concentration of 7.5 mg/L.

quote: During the acclimatization period, the fish were fed in a prescribed manner at scheduled intervals for two weeks.
statement: 在驯化期间，鱼类按预定方式定时投喂两周。
text_zh: 在驯化期间，鱼类按预定方式定时投喂两周。
text_en: During the acclimation period, fish were fed at scheduled times for two weeks.

quote: Research has shown that ω-3 PUFAs can improve inflammatory responses.
statement: 研究表明ω-3多不饱和脂肪酸可以改善炎症反应。
text_zh: 研究表明ω-3多不饱和脂肪酸可以改善炎症反应。
text_en: Studies show that omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids can improve inflammatory responses.

quote: Arachidonic acid, as an inflammatory signaling factor in the biosynthesis metabolic pathway of unsaturated fatty acids, can improve oxidative stress reactions and regulate lipid metabolism [ 53 ].
statement: 花生四烯酸作为不饱和脂肪酸生物合成代谢途径中的炎症信号因子，可以改善氧化应激反应并调节脂质代谢。
text_zh: 花生四烯酸作为不饱和脂肪酸生物合成代谢途径中的炎症信号因子，可以改善氧化应激反应并调节脂质代谢。
text_en: Arachidonic acid, as an inflammatory signaling factor in the biosynthetic metabolic pathway of unsaturated fatty acids, can improve oxidative stress responses and regulate lipid metabolism.
outcome: 氧化应激反应及脂质代谢

quote: Pituitaries were obtained from 18 females (the mean body weight 259 ± 0.41 g) after decapitation.
statement: 垂体是在雌性鲫鱼被斩首后获取的。
text_zh: 垂体是在雌性鲫鱼被斩首后获取的。
text_en: The pituitary gland was obtained from female crucian carp after decapitation.

quote: There is evidence showing the adverse effect of glyphosate or GBHs on zebrafish ovarian maturation and final oocyte maturation
statement: 有证据表明草甘膦或草甘膦除草剂对斑马鱼卵巢成熟和最终卵母细胞成熟具有不利影响。
text_zh: 有证据表明草甘膦或草甘膦除草剂对斑马鱼卵巢成熟和最终卵母细胞成熟具有不利影响。
text_en: There is evidence that glyphosate or glyphosate-based herbicides have adverse effects on zebrafish ovarian maturation and final oocyte maturation.

quote: In vivo adult zebrafish females’ exposure to Roundup for 15 days resulted in such ultrastructural changes in the ovary as: vacuolization in follicular cells, increased perivitelline space, and impaired mitochondria.
statement: 成年雌性斑马鱼体内暴露于Roundup 15天导致卵巢出现超微结构变化，如卵泡细胞空泡化、卵周隙增加和线粒体受损。
text_zh: 成年雌性斑马鱼体内暴露于Roundup 15天导致卵巢出现超微结构变化，如卵泡细胞空泡化、卵周隙增加和线粒体受损。
text_en: Exposure of adult female zebrafish to Roundup for 15 days caused ultrastructural changes in the ovaries, such as vacuolization of follicular cells, increased perivitelline space, and mitochondrial damage.

quote: The identified glycerophosphocholine (GPC) in this study, upregulated significantly in 3n but not significantly in 2n at CA20 concentration, indicated that 2n exhibits a favorable adaptive response to low carbonate saline-alkaline-concentration stress compared to 3n.
statement: 在CA20浓度下，2倍体（2n）甘油磷酸胆碱（GPC）未显著上调而3倍体（3n）显著上调，表明2倍体对低浓度碳酸盐盐碱胁迫表现出比3倍体更有利的适应性反应。
text_zh: 在CA20浓度下，2倍体（2n）甘油磷酸胆碱（GPC）未显著上调而3倍体（3n）显著上调，表明2倍体对低浓度碳酸盐盐碱胁迫表现出比3倍体更有利的适应性反应。

quote: However, both showed a downregulation trend in CA60, with 3n exhibiting a significantly higher degree of downregulation than 2n. This suggested that with increasing saline-alkaline concentration, the organism’s stress response surpassed its tolerance, exacerbating damage and compromising its ability to maintain GPC balance.
statement: 在CA60浓度下，两者均呈下调趋势且3倍体下调程度显著高于2倍体，这表明随着盐碱浓度增加，生物体的应激反应超过其耐受极限，加剧了损伤并损害了维持GPC平衡的能力。
text_zh: 在CA60浓度下，两者均呈下调趋势且3倍体下调程度显著高于2倍体，这表明随着盐碱浓度增加，生物体的应激反应超过其耐受极限，加剧了损伤并损害了维持GPC平衡的能力。

quote: Furthermore, in CA20 and CA60 concentrations, there was a significant downregulation trend of Lysophospholipids ... in 3n, while no significant changes were observed in 2n. These results collectively suggested that under high carbonate saline-alkaline stress, the rate of lipid peroxidation was faster in 3n than in 2n.
statement: 在CA20和CA60浓度下，3倍体的溶血磷脂显著下调而2倍体无显著变化，结果表明在高碳酸盐盐碱胁迫下，3倍体的脂质过氧化速率快于2倍体。
text_zh: 在CA20和CA60浓度下，3倍体的溶血磷脂显著下调而2倍体无显著变化，结果表明在高碳酸盐盐碱胁迫下，3倍体的脂质过氧化速率快于2倍体。

quote: Warningly, these widely used chemicals (GBHs/Roundup) of environmental concern are detected not only in a freshwater environment [ 9 , 11 , 12 ] but also in tissues of non-target aquatic and terrestrial organisms [ 13 , 14 ], and the levels of their/GBHs residuals are escalating [ 15 ].
statement: 草甘膦类除草剂（如Roundup）不仅存在于淡水环境中，也在非靶标水生和陆生生物的组织中被检测到，且其残留水平正在上升。
text_zh: 草甘膦类除草剂（如Roundup）不仅存在于淡水环境中，也在非靶标水生和陆生生物的组织中被检测到，且其残留水平正在上升。
text_en: Glyphosate-based herbicides (such as Roundup) are present not only in freshwater environments but have also been detected in the tissues of non-target aquatic and terrestrial organisms, and their residue levels are rising.
outcome: 环境污染物残留与暴露

quote: Moreover, an excessively high content of ω-3 PUFAs can inhibit immune function and increase lipid oxidation [ 55 ].
statement: 此外，过高的ω-3多不饱和脂肪酸含量会抑制免疫功能并增加脂质氧化。
text_zh: 此外，过高的ω-3多不饱和脂肪酸含量会抑制免疫功能并增加脂质氧化。
text_en: In addition, excessively high omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acid content inhibits immune function and increases lipid oxidation.

quote: This suggested that oxidative stress reactions were more severe in 3n than in 2n under saline-alkaline stress, leading to the disturbance of biosynthesis metabolic pathways of unsaturated fatty acids involving DHA and triggering inflammation and cell apoptosis in crucian carp cells.
statement: 这表明在盐碱胁迫下，三倍体的氧化应激反应比二倍体更严重，导致涉及DHA的不饱和脂肪酸生物合成代谢途径紊乱，并触发鲫鱼细胞的炎症和细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 这表明在盐碱胁迫下，三倍体的氧化应激反应比二倍体更严重，导致涉及DHA的不饱和脂肪酸生物合成代谢途径紊乱，并触发鲫鱼细胞的炎症和细胞凋亡。
text_en: This indicates that under salt-alkali stress, the oxidative stress response of triploids is more severe than that of diploids, leading to disruption of the unsaturated fatty acid biosynthesis metabolic pathway involving DHA, and triggering inflammation and apoptosis in crucian carp cells.
outcome: 氧化应激、炎症与细胞凋亡

quote: This indicated that under saline-alkaline stress, the increase in the content of DHA and OA in 3n was excessive, inhibiting the body’s immune function and causing an imbalance in the body’s immune and antioxidant systems, resulting in aggravated lipid metabolism disorders.
statement: 这表明在盐碱胁迫下，三倍体中DHA和OA含量的增加过度，抑制了机体的免疫功能，导致机体免疫和抗氧化系统失衡，从而加重了脂质代谢障碍。
text_zh: 这表明在盐碱胁迫下，三倍体中DHA和OA含量的增加过度，抑制了机体的免疫功能，导致机体免疫和抗氧化系统失衡，从而加重了脂质代谢障碍。
text_en: This indicates that under salt-alkali stress, the excessive increase in DHA and OA content in triploids inhibited the immune function of the organism, leading to an imbalance between the immune and antioxidant systems, thereby aggravating lipid metabolism disorders.
outcome: 免疫功能、抗氧化系统与脂质代谢

quote: Therefore, under carbonate saline-alkaline stress, the inflammatory symptoms of 3n were significantly more severe than those of 2n.
statement: 因此，在碳酸盐型盐碱胁迫下，三倍体的炎症症状明显比二倍体严重。
text_zh: 因此，在碳酸盐型盐碱胁迫下，三倍体的炎症症状明显比二倍体严重。
text_en: Therefore, under carbonate-type saline-alkali stress, the inflammatory symptoms of triploids are significantly more severe than those of diploids.

quote: Specifically, the disturbance in serum sphingolipid metabolism suggested that both 2n and 3n experienced toxicity under NaHCO 3 stress, with 3n displaying greater sensitivity to saline-alkaline stress, evidenced by its weaker capacity to regulate oxidative stress and inflammatory responses, resulting in reduced tolerance to external saline-alkaline environments.
statement: 在碳酸氢钠胁迫下，二倍体和三倍体鲫鱼均经历毒性，但三倍体表现出对盐碱胁迫的更高敏感性，其调节氧化应激和炎症反应的能力较弱，导致对外部盐碱环境的耐受性降低。
text_zh: 在碳酸氢钠胁迫下，二倍体和三倍体鲫鱼均经历毒性，但三倍体表现出对盐碱胁迫的更高敏感性，其调节氧化应激和炎症反应的能力较弱，导致对外部盐碱环境的耐受性降低。
text_en: Under sodium bicarbonate stress, both diploid and triploid crucian carp experienced toxicity, but triploids showed higher sensitivity to saline-alkali stress, with a weaker ability to regulate oxidative stress and inflammatory responses, resulting in reduced tolerance to the external saline-alkali environment.

quote: Conversely, pathways related to glycerophospholipid metabolism and the biosynthesis of unsaturated fatty acids appeared to mitigate the organismal damage caused by saline-alkaline stress.
statement: 与甘油磷脂代谢和不饱和脂肪酸生物合成相关的途径似乎减轻了由盐碱胁迫引起的机体损伤。
text_zh: 与甘油磷脂代谢和不饱和脂肪酸生物合成相关的途径似乎减轻了由盐碱胁迫引起的机体损伤。
text_en: Pathways related to glycerophospholipid metabolism and biosynthesis of unsaturated fatty acids appear to alleviate body damage caused by saline-alkali stress.

quote: Roundup induced developmental and physiological effects in fish after early life exposure to this herbicide [ 4 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ].
statement: 早期生命阶段接触Roundup后，该除草剂在鱼类中诱导了发育和生理效应。
text_zh: 早期生命阶段接触Roundup后，该除草剂在鱼类中诱导了发育和生理效应。
text_en: Exposure to Roundup during early life stages induced developmental and physiological effects in fish.

quote: In this study, we used PCR−DGGE technology to monitor the gut microbiota community changes in healthy and dis-eased gibel carp Carassius auratus upon trimetho-prim/sulfamethoxazole exposure.
statement: 本研究使用PCR-DGGE技术监测健康及患病银鲫在甲氧苄啶/磺胺甲恶唑暴露下的肠道菌群群落变化。
text_zh: 本研究使用PCR-DGGE技术监测健康及患病银鲫在甲氧苄啶/磺胺甲恶唑暴露下的肠道菌群群落变化。
text_en: This study used PCR-DGGE technology to monitor changes in the gut microbiota community of healthy and diseased gibel carp exposed to trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole.
intervention_record: 甲氧苄啶/磺胺甲恶唑治疗

quote: The objective of this study was to assess the effect of oral treatment with trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole on the gastrointestinal (GI) microbiota of healthy gibel carp and those affected with bacterial enteritis.
statement: 本研究的目的是评估口服甲氧苄啶/磺胺甲噁唑对健康鲫鱼和患细菌性肠炎鲫鱼的胃肠道微生物群的影响。
text_zh: 本研究的目的是评估口服甲氧苄啶/磺胺甲噁唑对健康鲫鱼和患细菌性肠炎鲫鱼的胃肠道微生物群的影响。
text_en: The purpose of this study was to evaluate the effects of oral trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole on the gastrointestinal microbiota of healthy crucian carp and crucian carp with bacterial enteritis.
intervention_record: 口服甲氧苄啶/磺胺甲恶唑

quote: administration of antibiotics had a more profound impact on the intestinal microflora of healthy fish than of the diseased ones
statement: 与健康鱼相比，抗生素给药对患病鱼的肠道菌群影响较小（即对健康鱼影响更深远）。
text_zh: 与健康鱼相比，抗生素给药对患病鱼的肠道菌群影响较小（即对健康鱼影响更深远）。
text_en: Compared to healthy fish, antibiotic administration had a smaller effect on the gut microbiota of diseased fish (i.e., it had a more profound effect on healthy fish).

quote: After 2 mo, fish cultured near the outlet began to die.
statement: 在池塘出口附近养殖的鱼在两个月后开始死亡。
text_zh: 在池塘出口附近养殖的鱼在两个月后开始死亡。
text_en: Fish farmed near the pond outlet began to die after two months.

quote: However, the fish reared near the inlet seemed to be healthy and no such bacterial pathogens were identified.
statement: 然而，在进水口附近养殖的鱼看起来健康，且未鉴定出此类细菌病原体。
text_zh: 然而，在进水口附近养殖的鱼看起来健康，且未鉴定出此类细菌病原体。
text_en: However, fish farmed near the inlet appeared healthy, and no such bacterial pathogens were identified.

quote: Two subgroups (1 healthy and 1 diseased) were fed new fodder that contained 1.5 g trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole per 1 kg diet (the ratio of trimethoprim and sulfamethoxazole was 1: 5, w/w), and 2 other subgroups were fed the same extruded diet without antibiotics.
statement: 两个亚组（1个健康组和1个患病组）喂食含有每千克饲料1.5克甲氧苄啶/磺胺甲恶唑的新饲料，另外两个亚组喂食相同的无抗生素挤压饲料。
text_zh: 两个亚组（1个健康组和1个患病组）喂食含有每千克饲料1.5克甲氧苄啶/磺胺甲恶唑的新饲料，另外两个亚组喂食相同的无抗生素挤压饲料。
text_en: Two subgroups (1 healthy group and 1 diseased group) were fed a new feed containing 1.5 g of trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole per kg of feed, while the other two subgroups were fed the same antibiotic-free extruded feed.
intervention_record: 口服甲氧苄啶/磺胺甲恶唑

quote: After 4 d, bacterial enteritis was successfully controlled and no addi-tional dead fish were dete
statement: 4天后，细菌性肠炎得到成功控制，且未检测到额外的死鱼。
text_zh: 4天后，细菌性肠炎得到成功控制，且未检测到额外的死鱼。
text_en: 4 days later, bacterial enteritis was successfully controlled, and no additional dead fish were detected.
intervention_record: 口服甲氧苄啶/磺胺甲恶唑

quote: Therefore, antibiotics also promote more bacterial species (23 bands in healthy treated groups vs. <20 bands in other groups; Fig. 1 & Table 2) under the selective pressure in healthy fish.
statement: 抗生素在健康鱼的选择压力下促进了更多的细菌物种（处理组有23条带，而其他组少于20条带）。
text_zh: 抗生素在健康鱼的选择压力下促进了更多的细菌物种（处理组有23条带，而其他组少于20条带）。
text_en: Antibiotics promoted more bacterial species under selection pressure in healthy fish (the treatment group had 23 bands, while other groups had fewer than 20 bands).

quote: After exposure to Roundup, the presence of accumulated cytoplasm under the chorion was more abundant (Figure 4 B–D).
statement: 暴露于Roundup后，卵膜下积累的细胞质更多。
text_zh: 暴露于Roundup后，卵膜下积累的细胞质更多。
text_en: After exposure to Roundup, more cytoplasm accumulated under the egg membrane.

quote: However, the sustainable production of Pengze crucian carp is increasingly threatened by challenges, including inbreeding depression, germplasm degradation, and declining stress resistance, which can negatively impact both yield and quality traits [ 2 ].
statement: 近亲繁殖衰退、种质退化和抗应激能力下降等挑战威胁着彭泽鲫的可持续生产，并可能对产量和品质性状产生负面影响。
text_zh: 近亲繁殖衰退、种质退化和抗应激能力下降等挑战威胁着彭泽鲫的可持续生产，并可能对产量和品质性状产生负面影响。
text_en: Challenges such as inbreeding depression, germplasm degradation, and reduced stress resistance threaten the sustainable production of Pengze crucian carp and may negatively affect yield and quality traits.
outcome: 抗应激能力与种质健康

quote: The antibiotic treatment changed the gut bacterial communities in healthy and recovered fish, and the effect and duration of such changes need to be investigated further.
statement: 抗生素处理改变了健康鱼和恢复期鱼的肠道细菌群落，且这种改变的影响和持续时间需要进一步研究。
text_zh: 抗生素处理改变了健康鱼和恢复期鱼的肠道细菌群落，且这种改变的影响和持续时间需要进一步研究。
text_en: Antibiotic treatment altered the gut bacterial communities of healthy and recovering fish, and the impact and duration of this change require further study.
intervention_record: 甲氧苄啶/磺胺甲恶唑治疗
limitations: effect and duration of such changes need to be investigated further

quote: This is the first time that the effect of treatment with antibiotics on the intestinal microbiota of fish has been determined using PCR−DGGE technology.
statement: 这是首次使用PCR-DGGE技术确定抗生素处理对鱼类肠道微生物群的影响。
text_zh: 这是首次使用PCR-DGGE技术确定抗生素处理对鱼类肠道微生物群的影响。
text_en: This is the first time PCR-DGGE technology has been used to determine the effects of antibiotic treatment on fish gut microbiota.

quote: The antibiotic effect was mainly observed in the bacterial communities of the hindgut of diseased fish (Table 1, Fig. 2).
statement: 抗生素效应主要在患病鱼后肠的细菌群落中观察到。
text_zh: 抗生素效应主要在患病鱼后肠的细菌群落中观察到。
text_en: The antibiotic effect was mainly observed in the bacterial community of the hindgut of diseased fish.

quote: Compared with healthy fish, the eco logical equilibrium of the intestinal microbiota of diseased fish had been changed by the presence of bacterial enteritis pathogens.
statement: 与健康鱼相比，细菌性肠炎病原体的存在改变了患病鱼肠道微生物群的生态平衡。
text_zh: 与健康鱼相比，细菌性肠炎病原体的存在改变了患病鱼肠道微生物群的生态平衡。
text_en: Compared with healthy fish, the presence of bacterial enteritis pathogens altered the ecological balance of the gut microbiota in diseased fish.
outcome: 肠道微生物群生态平衡

quote: With exposure to anti biotics, the similarities of bacterial communities of Samples C1 and C2 (0.29) and that of Samples D1 and D2 (0.46) were low.
statement: 接触抗生素后，健康鱼前后肠（0.29）和患病鱼前后肠（0.46）细菌群落的相似度较低。
text_zh: 接触抗生素后，健康鱼前后肠（0.29）和患病鱼前后肠（0.46）细菌群落的相似度较低。
text_en: After antibiotic exposure, the similarity of bacterial communities in the foregut and hindgut was low for healthy fish (0.29) and diseased fish (0.46).

quote: The changes in the physical properties of the egg surface caused by various adverse environmental factors, such as Roundup, may disturb the water uptake and ion exchange between the perivitelline fluid and the aquatic environment, which in consequence, may also affect egg swelling [ 5 ].
statement: 由Roundup等各种不利环境因素引起的卵表面物理性质变化，可能会扰乱卵黄周液与水环境之间的水分吸收和离子交换，进而可能影响卵的膨胀。
text_zh: 由Roundup等各种不利环境因素引起的卵表面物理性质变化，可能会扰乱卵黄周液与水环境之间的水分吸收和离子交换，进而可能影响卵的膨胀。
text_en: Changes in the physical properties of the egg surface caused by various adverse environmental factors such as Roundup may disrupt water absorption and ion exchange between the perivitelline fluid and the aquatic environment, thereby potentially affecting egg swelling.
outcome: 生殖健康（卵膨胀/水盐平衡）

quote: Studies by Ługowska [ 4 , 5 ] have shown the adverse effect of Roundup water contamination on common carp (Cyprinus carpio L.) and grass carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella) egg swelling.
statement: Ługowska的研究显示，Roundup水体污染对鲤鱼和草鱼的卵膨胀产生不利影响。
text_zh: Ługowska的研究显示，Roundup水体污染对鲤鱼和草鱼的卵膨胀产生不利影响。
text_en: Research by Ługowska showed that Roundup water pollution had an adverse effect on egg swelling in common carp and grass carp.

population.species: 鲤鱼 (Cyprinus carpio), 草鱼 (Ctenopharyngodon idella)

quote: PCR−DGGE technology was proved to be a rapid and reliable approach to monitor the diversity and dynamics of intestinal microbiota and to identify pathogens for efficient control.
statement: PCR-DGGE技术被证明是监测肠道微生物群多样性和动态以及识别病原体以实现高效控制的快速可靠方法。
text_zh: PCR-DGGE技术被证明是监测肠道微生物群多样性和动态以及识别病原体以实现高效控制的快速可靠方法。
text_en: PCR-DGGE technology has been proven to be a rapid and reliable method for monitoring gut microbiota diversity and dynamics, as well as identifying pathogens for efficient control.
outcome: 病原体识别与肠道微生物群监测

quote: The lower similar-ities of bacterial community structures of Samples C1 and C2 (0.29) and Samples D1 and D2 (0.46), compared to similarities between the fore- and hindgut in untreated (diseased and healthy) fish, suggested that the microfauna of fore- and hindgut were differentially affected by the antibiotics used here.
statement: 与未处理鱼的前肠和后肠之间的相似性相比，样本C1和C2（0.29）以及样本D1和D2（0.46）的细菌群落结构相似性较低，表明前肠和后肠的微动物区系受到此处使用的抗生素的不同影响。
text_zh: 与未处理鱼的前肠和后肠之间的相似性相比，样本C1和C2（0.29）以及样本D1和D2（0.46）的细菌群落结构相似性较低，表明前肠和后肠的微动物区系受到此处使用的抗生素的不同影响。
text_en: Compared to the similarity between the foregut and hindgut of untreated fish, the bacterial community structure similarities of samples C1 and C2 (0.29) and samples D1 and D2 (0.46) were lower, indicating that the microfauna in the foregut and hindgut were differentially affected by the antibiotics used here.
intervention_record: 甲氧苄啶/磺胺甲恶唑治疗
outcome: 肠道微生物群落结构变化

quote: However, Sample B2 (diseased fish hindgut) without contact with antibiotics clustered with those with the antibiotic treatment, which may be caused by the bacterial enteritis.
statement: 然而，未接触抗生素的患病鱼后肠样本B2与接受抗生素治疗的样本聚类在一起，这可能是由细菌性肠炎引起的。
text_zh: 然而，未接触抗生素的患病鱼后肠样本B2与接受抗生素治疗的样本聚类在一起，这可能是由细菌性肠炎引起的。
text_en: However, the hindgut sample B2 from diseased fish not exposed to antibiotics clustered with samples that received antibiotic treatment, which may be caused by bacterial enteritis.
outcome: 疾病对肠道微生物群落的影响

quote: The fish were fed a high-quality commercial crucian carp diet containing 32% crude protein and 4% crude lipid (Jiangxi Wujiahao Agricultural and Animal Husbandry Trade Co., Ltd., Nanchang, China).
statement: 鱼饲喂了含有32%粗蛋白和4%粗脂的高质量商业鲫鱼饲料。
text_zh: 鱼饲喂了含有32%粗蛋白和4%粗脂的高质量商业鲫鱼饲料。
text_en: Fish were fed a high-quality commercial crucian carp feed containing 32% crude protein and 4% crude fat.

quote: The fish were fed twice daily at 9:00 and 17:00, with feeding amounts adjusted based on fish intake, water temperature, and weather conditions.
statement: 每天在9:00和17:00喂食两次，并根据鱼的摄入量、水温和天气条件调整喂食量。
text_zh: 每天在9:00和17:00喂食两次，并根据鱼的摄入量、水温和天气条件调整喂食量。
text_en: Fed twice daily at 9:00 and 17:00, with feeding amounts adjusted according to fish intake, water temperature, and weather conditions.

quote: During the experiment, water quality was regularly monitored, maintaining dissolved oxygen ≥ 5.6 mg/L, ammonia nitrogen ≤ 0.2 mg/L, nitrite ≤ 0.1 mg/L, pH 7.8–8.5, and water temperature 22–30 °C.
statement: 实验期间定期监测水质，维持溶解氧≥5.6 mg/L，氨氮≤0.2 mg/L，亚硝酸盐≤0.1 mg/L，pH值7.8–8.5，水温22–30°C。
text_zh: 实验期间定期监测水质，维持溶解氧≥5.6 mg/L，氨氮≤0.2 mg/L，亚硝酸盐≤0.1 mg/L，pH值7.8–8.5，水温22–30°C。
text_en: During the experiment, water quality was regularly monitored, maintaining dissolved oxygen ≥5.6 mg/L, ammonia nitrogen ≤0.2 mg/L, nitrite ≤0.1 mg/L, pH 7.8–8.5, and water temperature 22–30°C.

quote: Survival (%) = 100 × (final fish number/initial fish number).
statement: 存活率通过最终鱼数除以初始鱼数再乘以100来计算。
text_zh: 存活率通过最终鱼数除以初始鱼数再乘以100来计算。
text_en: Survival rate is calculated by dividing the final number of fish by the initial number of fish and multiplying by 100.

quote: FCR = feed intake (dry weight, g)/[final weight (g) − initial weight (g)].
statement: 饲料系数通过摄食量（干重）除以体重增加量来计算。
text_zh: 饲料系数通过摄食量（干重）除以体重增加量来计算。
text_en: The feed conversion ratio is calculated by dividing the feed intake (dry weight) by the weight gain.

quote: After a 4-week rearing period in containers (6 m × 2 m × 2 m) at the Jiangxi Fisheries Research Institute base, 2400 healthy fish of uniform size were randomly selected and divided into the T-PZ group (initial weight 80.55 ± 5.08) and A-PZ group (initial weight 84.83 ± 4.79 g), with 3 containers per group (800 fish per container).
statement: 研究将鱼在容器中饲养4周，并按每组3个容器、每容器800条鱼的密度进行分组。
text_zh: 研究将鱼在容器中饲养4周，并按每组3个容器、每容器800条鱼的密度进行分组。
text_en: The study kept fish in containers for 4 weeks, grouped with 3 containers per group and a density of 800 fish per container.

quote: the final body weight (FBW), weight gain (WG) and survival of the T-PZ group were significantly lower than those of the A-PZ group
statement: T-PZ组的终末体重、增重率和存活率显著低于A-PZ组。
text_zh: T-PZ组的终末体重、增重率和存活率显著低于A-PZ组。
text_en: The final body weight, weight gain rate, and survival rate of the T-PZ group were significantly lower than those of the A-PZ group.

quote:
d slight changes in healthy fish gut after the
antibiotic treatment, both bands showing high simi-
larities to Enterobacteriaceae.
statement: 抗生素处理后，健康鱼肠道菌群出现轻微变化，相关条带与肠杆菌科高度相似。
text_zh: 抗生素处理后，健康鱼肠道菌群出现轻微变化，相关条带与肠杆菌科高度相似。
text_en: After antibiotic treatment, the gut microbiota of healthy fish showed slight changes, with related bands being highly similar to Enterobacteriaceae.

quote:
Enterobacteriaceae might be the major drug-resis-
tant bacteria in gibel carp intestine.
statement: 肠杆菌科可能是鲫鱼肠道中的主要耐药菌。
text_zh: 肠杆菌科可能是鲫鱼肠道中的主要耐药菌。
text_en: Enterobacteriaceae may be the main drug-resistant bacteria in the gut of crucian carp.

quote:
Sal-
monella has been found in contaminated fish feed.
statement: 已在受污染的鱼饲料中发现沙门氏菌。
text_zh: 已在受污染的鱼饲料中发现沙门氏菌。
text_en: Salmonella has been found in contaminated fish feed.

quote:
In
an aquaculture operation study of freshwater fish in
Guangdong Province, China (Broughton & Walker
2009), Salmonella sp. was isolated and showed sus-
ceptibility to neomycin, cefotaxime and cefepime but
was resistant to erythromycin and penicillin.
statement: 在中国广东省淡水鱼养殖操作研究中，分离出的沙门氏菌对新霉素、头孢噻肟和头孢吡肟敏感，但对红霉素和青霉素耐药。
text_zh: 在中国广东省淡水鱼养殖操作研究中，分离出的沙门氏菌对新霉素、头孢噻肟和头孢吡肟敏感，但对红霉素和青霉素耐药。
text_en: In a study of freshwater fish farming operations in Guangdong Province, China, the isolated Salmonella were sensitive to neomycin, cefotaxime and cefepime, but resistant to erythromycin and penicillin.

quote:
After
antibiotic treatment, Bands 18−26 appeared or inten-
sified, suggesting changes in the GI microbiota
diversity.
statement: 抗生素处理后，条带18-26出现或增强，表明胃肠道微生物多样性发生变化。
text_zh: 抗生素处理后，条带18-26出现或增强，表明胃肠道微生物多样性发生变化。
text_en: After antibiotic treatment, bands 18-26 appeared or intensified, indicating changes in gastrointestinal microbial diversity.

quote:
Antibiotic treatment might cause some
non-dominant bacterial species to become the domi-
nant ones.
statement: 抗生素处理可能导致某些非优势细菌物种成为优势物种。
text_zh: 抗生素处理可能导致某些非优势细菌物种成为优势物种。
text_en: Antibiotic treatment may cause certain non-dominant bacterial species to become dominant species.

quote: Furthermore, the observations have shown a decrease in common carp embryo survival [ 4 ], which was also reported by Fiorino et al. [ 7 ] and Socha et al. [ 10 ], pointing to the adverse effect of GBHs on the early life development of some, sensitive cyprinids.
statement: 观察显示鲤鱼胚胎存活率下降，这也被其他研究报道，表明Glyphosate-based herbicides (GBHs)对一些敏感的鲤科鱼类的早期生命发育有不利影响。
text_zh: 观察显示鲤鱼胚胎存活率下降，这也被其他研究报道，表明Glyphosate-based herbicides (GBHs)对一些敏感的鲤科鱼类的早期生命发育有不利影响。
text_en: Observations showed a decrease in carp embryo survival rate, which has also been reported by other studies, indicating that Glyphosate-based herbicides (GBHs) have adverse effects on the early life development of some sensitive cyprinid fish.

quote: However, the toxic effect on the chorionic proteins’ synthesis and chorion permeability and structure can be dose-dependent [ 56 ].
statement: 然而，对卵膜蛋白合成以及卵膜通透性和结构的毒性作用可能是剂量依赖性的。
text_zh: 然而，对卵膜蛋白合成以及卵膜通透性和结构的毒性作用可能是剂量依赖性的。
text_en: However, the toxic effects on chorion protein synthesis as well as chorion permeability and structure may be dose-dependent.

quote: Methionine, the initiating amino acid in protein synthesis [ 36 ], was identified alongside cysteine as the first limiting amino acid in both AAS and CS evaluations. Therefore, future development of specialized feeds for Pengze crucian carp should consider methionine supplementation.
statement: 蛋氨酸和半胱氨酸被鉴定为第一限制性氨基酸，因此未来开发彭泽鲫专用饲料应考虑补充蛋氨酸。
text_zh: 蛋氨酸和半胱氨酸被鉴定为第一限制性氨基酸，因此未来开发彭泽鲫专用饲料应考虑补充蛋氨酸。
text_en: Methionine and cysteine were identified as the first limiting amino acids, therefore future development of specialized feed for Pengze crucian carp should consider methionine supplementation.

text_en: The A-PZ group was significantly better than the T-PZ group in terms of final body weight, weight gain rate, survival rate, and feed conversion ratio.

quote: Since ferroptosis could be regulated and numbers of small molecule inhibitors, such as Vitamin E, the nature’s most-efficient ferroptosis inhibitor, have been identified [ 32 , 33 , 40 , 56 , 71 – 73 ], which suggests new prevention strategies and promising therapies of fish fatty liver.
statement: 铁死亡可以被调节，且维生素E等小分子抑制剂已被鉴定，这为鱼类脂肪肝提供了新的预防策略和有前景的治疗方法。
text_zh: 铁死亡可以被调节，且维生素E等小分子抑制剂已被鉴定，这为鱼类脂肪肝提供了新的预防策略和有前景的治疗方法。
text_en: Ferroptosis can be regulated, and small molecule inhibitors such as vitamin E have been identified, providing new prevention strategies and promising treatments for fish fatty liver.

quote: It might be activated by low temperature (Nile tilapia), hypoxia (Silver sillago) stress and heavy metal (Japanese flounder)
statement: 铁死亡可能由低温（尼罗罗非鱼）、缺氧应激（银鲳）和重金属（牙鲆）激活。
text_zh: 铁死亡可能由低温（尼罗罗非鱼）、缺氧应激（银鲳）和重金属（牙鲆）激活。
text_en: Ferroptosis may be activated by low temperature (Nile tilapia), hypoxia stress (Pomfret), and heavy metals (Japanese flounder).

population.species: Nile tilapia; Silver sillago; Japanese flounder

quote: and could be induced by Escherichia coli and then led to the red blood cells (RBCs) death of grass carp
statement: 大肠杆菌可诱导草鱼红细胞发生铁死亡。
text_zh: 大肠杆菌可诱导草鱼红细胞发生铁死亡。
text_en: Escherichia coli can induce ferroptosis in red blood cells of grass carp.

quote: Fatty liver diseases have been found in most main farmed fish, and caused many problems, such as low feed efficiency, immune response, flesh and nutritional quality effects [ 1 – 5 ].
statement: 大多数主要养殖鱼类均发现脂肪肝疾病，并导致饲料效率低、免疫反应以及肉质和营养品质受影响等问题。
text_zh: 大多数主要养殖鱼类均发现脂肪肝疾病，并导致饲料效率低、免疫反应以及肉质和营养品质受影响等问题。
text_en: Fatty liver disease has been found in most major farmed fish species, leading to problems such as low feed efficiency, immune response, and affected meat quality and nutritional quality.

quote: However, exceeding nutrition, improper artificial formulated diets and overfeeding have led to a growing concern of liver fatty problems, such as hepatocyte enlargement, lipid accumulation, steatosis, fibrosis and necrosis [ 10 , 11 ].
statement: 然而，营养过剩、不当的人工配合饲料和过度喂养导致了日益严重的肝脏脂肪问题，如肝细胞肿大、脂质积累、脂肪变性、纤维化和坏死。
text_zh: 然而，营养过剩、不当的人工配合饲料和过度喂养导致了日益严重的肝脏脂肪问题，如肝细胞肿大、脂质积累、脂肪变性、纤维化和坏死。
text_en: However, nutritional excess, improper artificial formulated diets and overfeeding have led to increasingly severe liver fat problems, such as hepatocyte swelling, lipid accumulation, steatosis, fibrosis and necrosis.
intervention: Excess nutrition, improper diets and overfeeding
intervention_record: 营养过剩与不当饲料及过量投喂

quote: Nutritional fatty liver, principally caused by imbalanced nutrition supply, is common in farmed fish and generally not a pathological symptom.
statement: 主要由营养供应不平衡引起的营养性脂肪肝在养殖鱼类中很常见，通常不是一种病理症状。
text_zh: 主要由营养供应不平衡引起的营养性脂肪肝在养殖鱼类中很常见，通常不是一种病理症状。
text_en: Nutritional fatty liver, mainly caused by imbalanced nutrition supply, is common in farmed fish and is usually not a pathological symptom.

quote: It can be alleviated through adjusting diet formulation or feeding.
statement: 通过调整饲料配方或投喂方式可以缓解营养性脂肪肝。
text_zh: 通过调整饲料配方或投喂方式可以缓解营养性脂肪肝。
text_en: Nutritional fatty liver can be alleviated by adjusting diet formulation or feeding methods.

quote: Compared to the individuals in the control group with normal liver, most of individuals in the overfeeding group had bulge belly and randomly selected of them had fatty liver in general appearance after dissecting.
statement: 与对照组正常肝脏个体相比，过量投喂组的大多数个体出现腹部膨大，且解剖后随机选取的个体普遍患有脂肪肝。
text_zh: 与对照组正常肝脏个体相比，过量投喂组的大多数个体出现腹部膨大，且解剖后随机选取的个体普遍患有脂肪肝。
text_en: Compared to individuals with normal livers in the control group, most individuals in the overfeeding group exhibited abdominal distension, and randomly selected individuals after dissection generally suffered from fatty liver.

quote: All fish were first totally immersed and deeply anesthetized with tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222, 35–40 mg/L, Servivebio, Wuhan) until losing all rhythmic opercular movements for a minimum of 30 min, then sacrificed by rapidly cutting off the spinal cord adjacent to the head.
statement: 所有鱼首先完全浸入并深度麻醉于三卡因甲磺酸盐（MS-222，35–40 mg/L）中，直至失去所有节律性鳃盖运动至少30分钟，然后通过迅速切断头部附近的脊髓进行处死。
text_zh: 所有鱼首先完全浸入并深度麻醉于三卡因甲磺酸盐（MS-222，35–40 mg/L）中，直至失去所有节律性鳃盖运动至少30分钟，然后通过迅速切断头部附近的脊髓进行处死。
text_en: All fish were first fully immersed and deeply anesthetized in tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222, 35–40 mg/L) until all rhythmic opercular movements ceased for at least 30 minutes, then euthanized by rapidly severing the spinal cord near the head.

quote: Procedures were performed to minimize fish suffering as far as possible.
statement: 操作程序旨在尽可能减少鱼的痛苦。
text_zh: 操作程序旨在尽可能减少鱼的痛苦。
text_en: The operating procedures are designed to minimize fish suffering as much as possible.

quote: Fatty liver has become a main problem that causes huge economic losses in many aquaculture modes.
statement: 脂肪肝已成为许多养殖模式中造成巨大经济损失的主要问题。
text_zh: 脂肪肝已成为许多养殖模式中造成巨大经济损失的主要问题。
text_en: Fatty liver has become a major problem causing huge economic losses in many farming models.

quote: Compared to normal liver, larger hepatocytes and more lipid accumulation were observed in fatty liver.
statement: 与正常肝脏相比，在脂肪肝中观察到更大的肝细胞和更多的脂质积累。
text_zh: 与正常肝脏相比，在脂肪肝中观察到更大的肝细胞和更多的脂质积累。
text_en: Compared to normal liver, larger hepatocytes and more lipid accumulation were observed in fatty liver.
outcome: 肝脏组织结构与脂质代谢

quote: Transcriptomic analysis between fatty liver and normal liver showed a totally different transcriptional trajectory.
statement: 脂肪肝与正常肝脏之间的转录组分析显示了完全不同的转录轨迹。
text_zh: 脂肪肝与正常肝脏之间的转录组分析显示了完全不同的转录轨迹。
text_en: Transcriptome analysis between fatty liver and normal liver showed completely different transcriptional trajectories.

quote: GO terms and KEGG pathways analyses revealed several enriched pathways in fatty liver, such as lipid biosynthesis, degradation accumulation, peroxidation, or metabolism and redox balance activities.
statement: GO术语和KEGG通路分析揭示了脂肪肝中几个富集的通路，如脂质生物合成、降解积累、过氧化或代谢及氧化还原平衡活动。
text_zh: GO术语和KEGG通路分析揭示了脂肪肝中几个富集的通路，如脂质生物合成、降解积累、过氧化或代谢及氧化还原平衡活动。
text_en: GO term and KEGG pathway analysis revealed several enriched pathways in fatty liver, such as lipid biosynthesis, degradation accumulation, peroxidation or metabolism, and redox balance activity.

quote: LPIA identified an activated ferroptosis pathway in the fatty liver.
statement: LPIA鉴定出脂肪肝中铁死亡通路的激活。
text_zh: LPIA鉴定出脂肪肝中铁死亡通路的激活。
text_en: LPIA identified the activation of ferroptosis pathways in fatty liver.

quote: qPCR analysis confirmed that gpx4 , a negative regulator of ferroptosis, was significantly downregulated while the other three positively regulated marker genes, such as acsl4 , tfr1 and gcl , were upregulated in fatty liver.
statement: qPCR分析证实，作为铁死亡负调控因子的gpx4在脂肪肝中显著下调，而其他三个正调控标记基因（如acsl4、tfr1和gcl）则上调。
text_zh: qPCR分析证实，作为铁死亡负调控因子的gpx4在脂肪肝中显著下调，而其他三个正调控标记基因（如acsl4、tfr1和gcl）则上调。
text_en: qPCR analysis confirmed that gpx4, a negative regulator of ferroptosis, was significantly downregulated in fatty liver, while the other three positive regulatory marker genes (such as acsl4, tfr1 and gcl) were upregulated.

quote: Moreover, the hepatocytes of fatty liver had more condensed mitochondria and some of their outer membranes were almost ruptured.
statement: 此外，脂肪肝的肝细胞具有更浓缩的线粒体，且部分线粒体外膜几乎破裂。
text_zh: 此外，脂肪肝的肝细胞具有更浓缩的线粒体，且部分线粒体外膜几乎破裂。
text_en: In addition, hepatocytes with fatty liver have more condensed mitochondria, and the outer membrane of some mitochondria is almost ruptured.

quote: We reveal an association between ferroptosis and fish fatty liver for the first time, suggesting that ferroptosis might be activated in liver fatty.
statement: 我们首次揭示了铁死亡与鱼类脂肪肝之间的关联，表明铁死亡可能在脂肪肝中被激活。
text_zh: 我们首次揭示了铁死亡与鱼类脂肪肝之间的关联，表明铁死亡可能在脂肪肝中被激活。
text_en: We revealed for the first time the association between ferroptosis and fish fatty liver, indicating that ferroptosis may be activated in fatty liver.

quote: However, some results seem to be controversial. For instance, the activation of Nrf2, JNK and TLRs-Myd88-NF-κB signaling pathways could lead to inflammation and worsen tilapia liver injury [ 12 ],
statement: 然而，一些结果似乎存在争议。例如，Nrf2、JNK和TLRs-Myd88-NF-κB信号通路的激活可能导致炎症并加重罗非鱼的肝损伤。
text_zh: 然而，一些结果似乎存在争议。例如，Nrf2、JNK和TLRs-Myd88-NF-κB信号通路的激活可能导致炎症并加重罗非鱼的肝损伤。
text_en: However, some results appear to be controversial. For example, activation of Nrf2, JNK and TLRs-Myd88-NF-κB signaling pathways may lead to inflammation and aggravate liver injury in tilapia.

quote: In lotus-fish farming ponds, we found some individuals of gibel carp had fatty liver.
statement: 在莲鱼养殖池塘中，发现部分银鲫个体患有脂肪肝。
text_zh: 在莲鱼养殖池塘中，发现部分银鲫个体患有脂肪肝。
text_en: In lotus-fish polyculture ponds, some silver crucian carp individuals were found to have fatty liver.

quote: Half of the juveniles was set as an overfeeding group, which was continuing feeding until without fish activities in apparent satiation two times per day.
statement: 实验将一半幼鱼设为过度投喂组，每天两次持续投喂直至观察到明显饱食后无活动为止。
text_zh: 实验将一半幼鱼设为过度投喂组，每天两次持续投喂直至观察到明显饱食后无活动为止。
text_en: The experiment set half of the juvenile fish as an overfeeding group, feeding them continuously twice a day until obvious satiation and no activity were observed.

population.system: 莲鱼共养池塘 (lotus-fish culturing ponds)

quote: The other half was set as a control group, which was cultured without artificial feeding.
statement: 另一半幼鱼作为对照组，不进行人工投喂进行养殖。
text_zh: 另一半幼鱼作为对照组，不进行人工投喂进行养殖。
text_en: The other half of the juvenile fish served as a control group and were raised without artificial feeding.

population.system: 莲鱼共养池塘 (lotus-fish culturing ponds)

quote: All the juveniles were cultured in lotus-fish culturing ponds at a density of 150 juveniles per 667 m 2 .
statement: 所有幼鱼均在莲鱼共养池塘中以每667平方米150尾的密度进行养殖。
text_zh: 所有幼鱼均在莲鱼共养池塘中以每667平方米150尾的密度进行养殖。
text_en: All juvenile fish were reared in lotus-fish co-culture ponds at a density of 150 individuals per 667 square meters.

population.system: 莲鱼共养池塘 (lotus-fish culturing ponds)

quote: Water samples were collected from three randomly ponds three times (April 22th, June 3th, October 12th, 2019). Eight physicochemical water quality parameters (water temperature, dissolved oxygen, pH, total nitrogen, ammonia, nitrate, nitrite and total phosphorus) were analyzed (Table S 7).
statement: 从三个随机池塘分三次采集水样，并分析了水温、溶解氧、pH等八项理化水质参数。
text_zh: 从三个随机池塘分三次采集水样，并分析了水温、溶解氧、pH等八项理化水质参数。
text_en: Water samples were collected in three batches from three random ponds, and eight physicochemical water quality parameters including water temperature, dissolved oxygen, and pH were analyzed.

population.system: 莲鱼共养池塘 (lotus-fish culturing ponds)

quote: If no effective strategy was carried on, it could be turned to the “oxidative fatty liver” or directly induced to hepatic fibrosis and necrosis, which causes irretrievable damages [ 1 ].
statement: 如果没有采取有效策略，营养性脂肪肝可能转变为氧化性脂肪肝或直接诱导肝纤维化和坏死，造成不可挽回的损害。
text_zh: 如果没有采取有效策略，营养性脂肪肝可能转变为氧化性脂肪肝或直接诱导肝纤维化和坏死，造成不可挽回的损害。
text_en: If effective strategies are not adopted, nutritional fatty liver may transform into oxidative fatty liver or directly induce hepatic fibrosis and necrosis, causing irreversible damage.

quote: Oxidative stress might lead to oxidative fatty liver, which would arouse severe liver damage [ 1 , 12 ].
statement: 氧化应激可能导致氧化性脂肪肝，从而引发严重的肝脏损伤。
text_zh: 氧化应激可能导致氧化性脂肪肝，从而引发严重的肝脏损伤。
text_en: Oxidative stress may lead to oxidative fatty liver, thereby causing severe liver damage.

quote: Overall, excess dietary energy intake and severe peroxidation can cause fish metabolic imbalance and then result in fatty livers.
statement: 总体而言，过量的膳食能量摄入和严重的过氧化会导致鱼类代谢失衡，进而导致脂肪肝。
text_zh: 总体而言，过量的膳食能量摄入和严重的过氧化会导致鱼类代谢失衡，进而导致脂肪肝。
text_en: Overall, excess dietary energy intake and severe peroxidation lead to metabolic imbalance in fish, which in turn leads to fatty liver.

quote: the prevalence of viral diseases, especially herpesvirus diseases, reported to be widespread in aquatic animals [ 6 , 7 ], has seriously affected the production and quality of aquatic products [ 8 ]
statement: 疱疹病毒病等水生动物中普遍存在的病毒性疾病严重影响了水产品的产量和质量。
text_zh: 疱疹病毒病等水生动物中普遍存在的病毒性疾病严重影响了水产品的产量和质量。
text_en: Viral diseases prevalent in aquatic animals, such as herpesvirus disease, severely affect the yield and quality of aquatic products.

quote: Importantly, a pathway of ferroptosis was significant different between normal liver and fatty liver that might be associated with lipid-related activities (Figs. 4 & 5), suggesting an association between ferroptosis and fish fatty liver.
statement: 铁死亡通路在正常肝和脂肪肝之间存在显著差异，且可能与脂质相关活动有关，提示铁死亡与鱼类脂肪肝之间存在关联。
text_zh: 铁死亡通路在正常肝和脂肪肝之间存在显著差异，且可能与脂质相关活动有关，提示铁死亡与鱼类脂肪肝之间存在关联。
text_en: There are significant differences in the ferroptosis pathway between normal liver and fatty liver, which may be related to lipid-associated activities, suggesting an association between ferroptosis and fatty liver disease in fish.

quote: Enzymes, such as glutathione peroxidase, could reduce the lipid peroxides in tilapia and other fish [ 48 , 49 ].
statement: 谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶等酶可以降低罗非鱼和其他鱼类中的脂质过氧化物。
text_zh: 谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶等酶可以降低罗非鱼和其他鱼类中的脂质过氧化物。
text_en: Enzymes such as glutathione peroxidase can reduce lipid peroxides in tilapia and other fish.

quote: Oxidants could damage mitochondrial membrane permeability and electron transport chain integrity in zebrafish and grass carp [ 50 – 52 ].
statement: 氧化剂可能损害斑马鱼和草鱼的线粒体膜通透性和电子传递链完整性。
text_zh: 氧化剂可能损害斑马鱼和草鱼的线粒体膜通透性和电子传递链完整性。
text_en: Oxidants may damage the mitochondrial membrane permeability and electron transport chain integrity of zebrafish and grass carp.

quote: Crucian carp were anesthetized with diluted tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222, Sigma, United States) at the concentration of 100 mg/L.
statement: 鲫鱼使用浓度为100 mg/L的稀释三卡因甲磺酸盐（MS-222）进行麻醉。
text_zh: 鲫鱼使用浓度为100 mg/L的稀释三卡因甲磺酸盐（MS-222）进行麻醉。
text_en: Crucian carp were anesthetized using tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222) at a concentration of 100 mg/L.

quote: Agar well-diffusion protocol was performed based on Schillinger and Lucke method (Schillinger and Lücke, 1989) to determine the antimicrobial activity of all isolates against the pathogenic bacteria such as Aeromonas veronii , Aeromonas hydrophila , Aeromonas caviae , Aeromonas salraonicida , Streptococcus agalactiae , Staphylococcus aureus , Escherichia coli, Salmonella Typhimurium , Salmonella choleraesuis , Clostridium perfringens , Proteus hauseri
statement: 采用基于Schillinger和Lucke方法的琼脂扩散法测定分离株对多种致病菌的抗菌活性。
text_zh: 采用基于Schillinger和Lucke方法的琼脂扩散法测定分离株对多种致病菌的抗菌活性。
text_en: Antimicrobial activity of isolates against multiple pathogenic bacteria was determined using the agar diffusion method based on the Schillinger and Lucke methods.

quote: The control group was fed on basal diet without probiotic supplementation, and the treatment groups were fed with B. velezensis coated basal diet (B. velezensis C-11, S-22, L-17, and S-14) at 3% of body weight twice daily (08:00 and 18:00 h) for 8 weeks.
statement: 对照组喂食不含益生菌的基础日粮，处理组喂食包被枯草芽孢杆菌（C-11、S-22、L-17和S-14）的基础日粮，投喂量为体重的3%，每日两次（08:00和18:00），持续8周。
text_zh: 对照组喂食不含益生菌的基础日粮，处理组喂食包被枯草芽孢杆菌（C-11、S-22、L-17和S-14）的基础日粮，投喂量为体重的3%，每日两次（08:00和18:00），持续8周。
text_en: The control group was fed a basal diet without probiotics, while the treatment group was fed a basal diet containing encapsulated Bacillus subtilis (C-11, S-22, L-17 and S-14). The feeding rate was 3% of body weight, twice daily (08:00 and 18:00), for 8 weeks.

quote: During the administration, the water and unconsumed feed were removed frequently with oxygen saturation, and temperature of water ranged from 26 to 31°C.
statement: 在给药期间，频繁移除水和未消耗的饲料以保持氧气饱和，水温范围为26至31°C。
text_zh: 在给药期间，频繁移除水和未消耗的饲料以保持氧气饱和，水温范围为26至31°C。
text_en: During the administration period, water and unconsumed feed were frequently removed to maintain oxygen saturation, with a water temperature range of 26 to 31°C.

quote: Healthy Crucian carp were administrated with Bacillus -supplemented feed or control feed (2% of body weight daily) for 5 weeks. The mortality, abnormal behaviors and clinical symptoms of injected fish were monitored daily.
statement: 健康鲫鱼饲喂添加芽孢杆菌的饲料或对照饲料（每日体重的2%）持续5周，并每日监测死亡率、异常行为和临床症状。
text_zh: 健康鲫鱼饲喂添加芽孢杆菌的饲料或对照饲料（每日体重的2%）持续5周，并每日监测死亡率、异常行为和临床症状。
text_en: Healthy crucian carp were fed diets supplemented with Bacillus subtilis or control diets (2% of body weight daily) for 5 weeks, and mortality, abnormal behavior, and clinical symptoms were monitored daily.

quote: The mortality, abnormal behaviors and clinical symptoms of injected fish were monitored daily.
statement: 注射鱼类的死亡率、异常行为和临床症状被每日监测。
text_zh: 注射鱼类的死亡率、异常行为和临床症状被每日监测。
text_en: Mortality, abnormal behavior, and clinical symptoms of injected fish were monitored daily.

quote: The methods of probiotics added into feed were widely applied in the aquatic animal (Ghosh et al., 2016).
statement: 将益生菌添加到饲料中的方法在水生动物中被广泛应用。
text_zh: 将益生菌添加到饲料中的方法在水生动物中被广泛应用。
text_en: The method of adding probiotics to feed is widely used in aquatic animals.

quote: Six hundred healthy crucian carp juveniles (body weight: 55.20 ± 1.2 g) procured from a local aquaculture farm were acclimatized to laboratory conditions for 2 weeks in flow-through aquariums (200 L) at 26 ± 1.0°C, as described above.
statement: 从当地养殖场获取的600尾健康鲫鱼幼鱼在26±1.0°C的流水水族箱中适应实验室条件2周。
text_zh: 从当地养殖场获取的600尾健康鲫鱼幼鱼在26±1.0°C的流水水族箱中适应实验室条件2周。
text_en: 600 healthy juvenile crucian carp obtained from local farms were acclimated to laboratory conditions in flow-through aquaria at 26±1.0°C for 2 weeks.

quote: Phagocytic activity of leukocytes were assessed as previously described (Geng et al., 2012).
statement: 白细胞吞噬活性按照先前描述的方法进行评估。
text_zh: 白细胞吞噬活性按照先前描述的方法进行评估。
text_en: Leukocyte phagocytic activity was evaluated according to previously described methods.

quote: Healthy Crucian carp were injected intraperitoneally with 100 μL of the identified strains and the control group was injected with the same volume of PBS. The abnormal behaviors and clinical symptoms of injected fish were monitored daily for 2 weeks.
statement: 健康鲫鱼被腹腔注射100微升鉴定菌株，对照组注射等量PBS，并每日监测注射鱼类的异常行为和临床症状持续2周。
text_zh: 健康鲫鱼被腹腔注射100微升鉴定菌株，对照组注射等量PBS，并每日监测注射鱼类的异常行为和临床症状持续2周。
text_en: Healthy crucian carp were intraperitoneally injected with 100 microliters of the identified strain, while the control group was injected with an equal volume of PBS, and abnormal behaviors and clinical symptoms of the injected fish were monitored daily for 2 weeks.

quote: Here, we speculated that probiotic could enhance the immune responses and intestinal epithelial barrier function.
statement: 作者推测益生菌可以增强免疫反应和肠道上皮屏障功能。
text_zh: 作者推测益生菌可以增强免疫反应和肠道上皮屏障功能。
text_en: The authors speculate that probiotics can enhance immune responses and intestinal epithelial barrier function.
outcome: 免疫反应与肠道屏障功能

quote: The effects of B. velezensis strains on cytokines gene expression, intestinal mucosal barrier function, and disease resistance in Crucian carp were investigated.
statement: 研究调查了贝莱斯芽孢杆菌菌株对鲫鱼细胞因子基因表达、肠黏膜屏障功能和疾病抵抗力的影响。
text_zh: 研究调查了贝莱斯芽孢杆菌菌株对鲫鱼细胞因子基因表达、肠黏膜屏障功能和疾病抵抗力的影响。
text_en: The study investigated the effects of Bacillus velezensis strains on cytokine gene expression, intestinal mucosal barrier function, and disease resistance in crucian carp.
outcome: 疾病抵抗力与肠道健康

quote: Therefore, the present study contributes to provide evidence that pathogen exclusion and protective effect in fish mediated by probiotic that enhances intestinal mucosal barrier function and inhibits pathogen colonization.
statement: 本研究旨在提供证据，证明由增强肠黏膜屏障功能并抑制病原体定植的益生菌介导的鱼类的病原体排除和保护作用。
text_zh: 本研究旨在提供证据，证明由增强肠黏膜屏障功能并抑制病原体定植的益生菌介导的鱼类的病原体排除和保护作用。
text_en: This study aims to provide evidence for the pathogen exclusion and protective effects in fish mediated by probiotics that enhance intestinal mucosal barrier function and inhibit pathogen colonization.
outcome: 病原体排除与保护作用

quote: Fish were acclimatized in flow-through aquariums (200 L) at 26 ± 1.0°C, with natural photoperiod.
statement: 鱼类在200升流水式水族箱中适应环境，温度为26±1.0°C，采用自然光周期。
text_zh: 鱼类在200升流水式水族箱中适应环境，温度为26±1.0°C，采用自然光周期。
text_en: Fish were acclimated in 200 L flow-through aquaria at a temperature of 26±1.0°C, using a natural photoperiod.
intervention_record: 流水箱饲养与自然光周期

quote: Fish were fed the basal diet twice a day in the amount of 2% of their body weight for 2 weeks.
statement: 鱼类每天喂食两次基础日粮，投喂量为体重的2%，持续2周。
text_zh: 鱼类每天喂食两次基础日粮，投喂量为体重的2%，持续2周。
text_en: Fish were fed a basal diet twice daily at 2% of body weight for 2 weeks.

quote: During the whole experiment periods, the physicochemical parameters of the water were measured daily (5.6 ± 0.45 mg/L of dissolved oxygen, 0.12 ± 0.01 mg/L of ammonia, 0.015 ± 0.003 mg/L of nitrate and 7.8 ± 0.5 of pH).
statement: 在整个实验期间，每天测量水的理化参数（溶解氧5.6±0.45 mg/L，氨氮0.12±0.01 mg/L，硝酸盐0.015±0.003 mg/L，pH值7.8±0.5）。
text_zh: 在整个实验期间，每天测量水的理化参数（溶解氧5.6±0.45 mg/L，氨氮0.12±0.01 mg/L，硝酸盐0.015±0.003 mg/L，pH值7.8±0.5）。
text_en: Throughout the experiment, physicochemical parameters of water were measured daily (dissolved oxygen 5.6±0.45 mg/L, ammonia nitrogen 0.12±0.01 mg/L, nitrate 0.015±0.003 mg/L, pH 7.8±0.5).

quote: However, widespread exposure of antibiotics remained in the aquaculture, which result in the emergence of drug-resistant pathogens and food safety concerns
statement: 然而，水产养殖中抗生素的广泛暴露仍然存在，这导致了耐药病原体的出现和食品安全问题。
text_zh: 然而，水产养殖中抗生素的广泛暴露仍然存在，这导致了耐药病原体的出现和食品安全问题。
text_en: However, widespread exposure to antibiotics in aquaculture still exists, leading to the emergence of resistant pathogens and food safety issues.

quote: There is increasing evidence that probiotics have emerged as preventive treatment for the invasion and colonization of pathogens
statement: 越来越多的证据表明，益生菌已成为预防病原体入侵和定植的治疗手段。
text_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，益生菌已成为预防病原体入侵和定植的治疗手段。
text_en: Increasing evidence shows that probiotics have become a therapeutic means to prevent pathogen invasion and colonization.

quote: Various microorganisms exert beneficial effects through controlling the balance of microbes in gut, enhancing growth performance and improving the ecosystem of gut microbiota have been considered as probiotics in aquaculture including Lactobacillus, Bacillus
statement: 各种微生物通过控制肠道微生物平衡、增强生长性能和改善肠道微生物群生态系统来发挥有益作用，这些微生物在水产养殖中被视为益生菌，包括乳杆菌属和芽孢杆菌属。
text_zh: 各种微生物通过控制肠道微生物平衡、增强生长性能和改善肠道微生物群生态系统来发挥有益作用，这些微生物在水产养殖中被视为益生菌，包括乳杆菌属和芽孢杆菌属。
text_en: Various microorganisms exert beneficial effects by controlling intestinal microbial balance, enhancing growth performance, and improving the gut microbiota ecosystem; these microorganisms are regarded as probiotics in aquaculture, including Lactobacillus and Bacillus.

quote: As shown in Supplementary Figure S3 , strain C-11, S-22, L-17, and S-14 have stronger ability of pathogen inhibition.
statement: 如补充图S3所示，菌株C-11、S-22、L-17和S-14具有更强的病原体抑制能力。
text_zh: 如补充图S3所示，菌株C-11、S-22、L-17和S-14具有更强的病原体抑制能力。
text_en: As shown in Supplementary Figure S3, strains C-11, S-22, L-17 and S-14 have stronger pathogen inhibition ability.

quote: qRT-PCR was performed using 7500 system (Applied Biosystem, United States) to quantify the relative expression levels of IL-1β, IL-10, TNF-α and IFN-γ, and β-actin was used as the internal control gene quantified by qRT-PCR.
statement: 通过qRT-PCR定量IL-1β、IL-10、TNF-α和IFN-γ的相对表达水平，以β-actin为内参。
text_zh: 通过qRT-PCR定量IL-1β、IL-10、TNF-α和IFN-γ的相对表达水平，以β-actin为内参。
text_en: The relative expression levels of IL-1β, IL-10, TNF-α and IFN-γ were quantified by qRT-PCR, with β-actin as the internal reference.

quote: Two days after the last bleeding, fish were anesthetized by bath immersion with 60 mg/L MS-222 for 10 min before challenge.
statement: 在攻毒前，鱼用60 mg/L MS-222浸泡麻醉10分钟。
text_zh: 在攻毒前，鱼用60 mg/L MS-222浸泡麻醉10分钟。
text_en: Before challenge, fish were anesthetized by immersion in 60 mg/L MS-222 for 10 minutes.

quote: Previous studies have demonstrated that B. velezensis exhibit considerable antagonistic against pathogen by producing versatile anti-microbial compounds, such as bacillomycin, surfactins, fengicins, and amylocyclicin (Palazzini et al., 2016 ; Fan et al., 2017).
statement: 先前的研究表明，贝莱斯芽孢杆菌通过产生多种抗菌化合物（如bacillomycin、surfactins、fengicins和amylocyclicin）对病原体表现出显著的拮抗作用。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，贝莱斯芽孢杆菌通过产生多种抗菌化合物（如bacillomycin、surfactins、fengicins和amylocyclicin）对病原体表现出显著的拮抗作用。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that Bacillus velezensis exhibits significant antagonism against pathogens by producing multiple antimicrobial compounds (such as bacillomycin, surfactins, fengicins and amylocyclicin).

quote: B. velezensis that possess antagonistic activity to A. salmonicida and A. hydrophila was isolated from marine recirculation aquaculture systems (RASs), and researchers have identified the structures of antimicrobial compounds from B. velezensis , which demonstrated that the isolate is an potential probiotic agent in Oncorhynchus mykiss (rainbow trout) (Gao et al., 2017).
statement: 从海洋循环水养殖系统中分离出的具有针对杀鲑气单胞菌和水产气单胞菌拮抗活性的B. velezensis，被证明是虹鳟鱼的潜在益生菌制剂。
text_zh: 从海洋循环水养殖系统中分离出的具有针对杀鲑气单胞菌和水产气单胞菌拮抗活性的B. velezensis，被证明是虹鳟鱼的潜在益生菌制剂。
text_en: B. velezensis isolated from marine recirculating aquaculture systems, which exhibits antagonistic activity against Aeromonas salmonicida and Aeromonas hydrophila, has been proven to be a potential probiotic preparation for rainbow trout.

quote: Of note, the limitations of antibiotics, vaccines, and probiotics in fish models suggest that aquaculture disease management should emphasize on harmless, preventative, and eco-friendly methods (Daniell et al., 2010).
statement: 抗生素、疫苗和益生菌在鱼类模型中的局限性表明，水产养殖疾病管理应强调无害、预防和环保的方法。
text_zh: 抗生素、疫苗和益生菌在鱼类模型中的局限性表明，水产养殖疾病管理应强调无害、预防和环保的方法。
text_en: The limitations of antibiotics, vaccines, and probiotics in fish models suggest that aquaculture disease management should emphasize harmless, preventive, and environmentally friendly methods.

quote: A. veronii can enter the fish through injury to the skin or gill, increasing colonization of opportunistic bacteria, and resulting in damage to the mucus cells (Parker and Shaw, 2011).
statement: 维氏气单胞菌可通过皮肤或鳃损伤进入鱼体，增加机会性细菌定植，并导致黏液细胞受损。
text_zh: 维氏气单胞菌可通过皮肤或鳃损伤进入鱼体，增加机会性细菌定植，并导致黏液细胞受损。
text_en: Aeromonas veronii can enter fish bodies through skin or gill damage, increase opportunistic bacterial colonization, and cause damage to mucus cells.

quote: Farming conditions alerted immune system in the gut, which increased transcript levels for immune-related genes of mid-intestine in Atlantic salmon, Salmo salar (Løkka et al., 2014).
statement: 养殖条件激活了肠道免疫系统，增加了大西洋鲑中肠免疫相关基因的转录水平。
text_zh: 养殖条件激活了肠道免疫系统，增加了大西洋鲑中肠免疫相关基因的转录水平。
text_en: Farming conditions activated the intestinal immune system and increased the transcription levels of immune-related genes in the midgut of Atlantic salmon.
