quote: The intestinal homeostasis is disrupted, which exacerbated intestinal inflammation, leading to the decrease lysozyme activity and down-regulate expression of tight junction proteins of intestine following A. hydrophila infection in Jian carp (Cyprinus carpio) (Wu et al., 2017).
statement: 在鲤感染嗜水气单胞菌后，肠道稳态被破坏，加剧了肠道炎症，导致溶菌酶活性降低和肠道紧密连接蛋白表达下调。
text_zh: 在鲤感染嗜水气单胞菌后，肠道稳态被破坏，加剧了肠道炎症，导致溶菌酶活性降低和肠道紧密连接蛋白表达下调。
text_en: After infection of carp with Aeromonas hydrophila, intestinal homeostasis is disrupted, exacerbating intestinal inflammation and leading to reduced lysozyme activity and downregulated expression of intestinal tight junction proteins.
outcome: 肠道炎症、溶菌酶活性及紧密连接蛋白表达

quote: Probiotic formulae containing spore-forming bacteria, which are proposed to prevent pathogen colonization by mechanisms that except for a described intestinal mucosal barrier function in aquatic animals remain poorly defined.
statement: 含有产孢细菌的益生菌配方被提出通过除已描述的水生动物肠道黏膜屏障功能外的机制来防止病原体定植，但这些机制仍不明确。
text_zh: 含有产孢细菌的益生菌配方被提出通过除已描述的水生动物肠道黏膜屏障功能外的机制来防止病原体定植，但这些机制仍不明确。
text_en: Probiotic formulations containing spore-forming bacteria have been proposed to prevent pathogen colonization through mechanisms other than the described intestinal mucosal barrier function in aquatic animals, but these mechanisms remain unclear.
limitations: 机制除肠道黏膜屏障外仍不明确

quote: Recently, the application of probiotics has concentrated in innate immunity, microbial community structure, and stress response in aquaculture (Zhou et al., 2016 ; Eissa et al., 2018).
statement: 最近，益生菌在水产养殖中的应用集中在先天免疫、微生物群落结构和应激反应方面。
text_zh: 最近，益生菌在水产养殖中的应用集中在先天免疫、微生物群落结构和应激反应方面。
text_en: Recently, the application of probiotics in aquaculture has focused on innate immunity, microbial community structure, and stress responses.
outcome: 先天免疫、微生物群落结构、应激反应

quote: Probiotics mixture improved the non-specific immune parameters to maintain survival rate in a fish model infected with A. sobria (Reda et al., 2018).
statement: 益生菌混合物改善了非特异性免疫参数，以维持感染温和气单胞菌的鱼模型的存活率。
text_zh: 益生菌混合物改善了非特异性免疫参数，以维持感染温和气单胞菌的鱼模型的存活率。
text_en: The probiotic mixture improved non-specific immune parameters to maintain the survival rate of fish models infected with Aeromonas sobria.
outcome: 非特异性免疫参数与存活率

quote: B. licheniformis inhibit pro-inflammatory cytokines TNF-α and IL-1β mRNA expression induced by A. hydrophila (Giri et al., 2017).
statement: 地衣芽孢杆菌抑制由嗜水气单胞菌诱导的促炎细胞因子TNF-α和IL-1β的mRNA表达。
text_zh: 地衣芽孢杆菌抑制由嗜水气单胞菌诱导的促炎细胞因子TNF-α和IL-1β的mRNA表达。
text_en: Bacillus licheniformis inhibited the mRNA expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines TNF-α and IL-1β induced by Aeromonas hydrophila.

quote: Probiotic is an effective strategy for controlling enteric infections through reducing intestinal colonization by pathogens.
statement: 益生菌是通过减少病原体在肠道内的定植来控制肠道感染的有效策略。
text_zh: 益生菌是通过减少病原体在肠道内的定植来控制肠道感染的有效策略。
text_en: Probiotics are an effective strategy for controlling intestinal infections by reducing pathogen colonization in the gut.

quote: Here we report that the consumption of Bacillus velezensis regulated the intestinal innate immune response and decreased the degree of intestinal inflammation damage caused by the A. veronii in Crucian carp.
statement: 本研究报告称，食用贝莱斯芽孢杆菌调节了鲤鱼的肠道先天免疫反应，并降低了由维氏气单胞菌引起的肠道炎症损伤程度。
text_zh: 本研究报告称，食用贝莱斯芽孢杆菌调节了鲤鱼的肠道先天免疫反应，并降低了由维氏气单胞菌引起的肠道炎症损伤程度。
text_en: This study reports that dietary Bacillus velezensis modulated the intestinal innate immune response of common carp and reduced the degree of intestinal inflammatory damage caused by Aeromonas veronii.

quote: In this study, we isolated four strains of B. velezensis , named C-11, S-22, L-17 and S-14 from apparently healthy Crucian carp, which exerted a broad-spectrum antimicrobial activity inhibiting both Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria especially the fish pathogens.
statement: 在本研究中，我们从表观健康的鲤鱼中分离出四株贝莱斯芽孢杆菌（命名为C-11、S-22、L-17和S-14），这些菌株表现出广谱抗菌活性，能抑制革兰氏阳性菌和阴性菌，特别是鱼类病原体。
text_zh: 在本研究中，我们从表观健康的鲤鱼中分离出四株贝莱斯芽孢杆菌（命名为C-11、S-22、L-17和S-14），这些菌株表现出广谱抗菌活性，能抑制革兰氏阳性菌和阴性菌，特别是鱼类病原体。
text_en: In this study, we isolated four Bacillus velezensis strains (named C-11, S-22, L-17 and S-14) from apparently healthy carp. These strains exhibited broad-spectrum antibacterial activity, inhibiting Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria, particularly fish pathogens.

quote: Here, Bacillus -containing dietary was orally administrated to Crucian carp for 8 weeks before A. veronii challenge.
statement: 在此，含有芽孢杆菌的饲料在维氏气单胞菌攻击前口服给予鲤鱼8周。
text_zh: 在此，含有芽孢杆菌的饲料在维氏气单胞菌攻击前口服给予鲤鱼8周。
text_en: Here, feed containing Bacillus was orally administered to carp for 8 weeks prior to Aeromonas veronii challenge.

quote: The results showed that B. velezensis was found to promote the increase in the phagocytic activities of peripheral blood leukocytes (PBLs) and head kidney leukocytes (HKLs), as well as the increase in interleukin 1β (IL-1β), IL-10 and tumor necrosis factor α (TNF-α) concentration of serum.
statement: 结果显示，发现贝莱斯芽孢杆菌促进了外周血白细胞(PBLs)和头肾白细胞(HKLs)吞噬活性的增加，以及血清中白细胞介素1β(IL-1β)、IL-10和肿瘤坏死因子α(TNF-α)浓度的增加。
text_zh: 结果显示，发现贝莱斯芽孢杆菌促进了外周血白细胞(PBLs)和头肾白细胞(HKLs)吞噬活性的增加，以及血清中白细胞介素1β(IL-1β)、IL-10和肿瘤坏死因子α(TNF-α)浓度的增加。
text_en: The results showed that Bacillus velezensis promoted an increase in the phagocytic activity of peripheral blood leukocytes (PBLs) and head kidney leukocytes (HKLs), as well as an increase in the concentrations of interleukin-1β (IL-1β), IL-10, and tumor necrosis factor α (TNF-α) in serum.

quote: Lysozyme levels (113.76 U/mL), ACP activity (25.32 U/mL), AKP activity (130.08 U/mL), and SOD activity (240.63 U/mL) were maximum (P B. velezensis C-11 treated group at 8 week.
statement: 溶菌酶水平(113.76 U/mL)、ACP活性(25.32 U/mL)、AKP活性(130.08 U/mL)和SOD活性(240.63 U/mL)在第8周的B. velezensis C-11处理组达到最大值。
text_en: 溶菌酶水平(113.76 U/mL)、ACP活性(25.32 U/mL)、AKP活性(130.08 U/mL)和SOD活性(240.63 U/mL)在第8周的B. velezensis C-11处理组达到最大值。

quote: Phagocytic activity is expressed as the percentage of cells calculated by enumerating 200 phagocytes under a microscope.
statement: 吞噬活性通过显微镜下计数200个吞噬细胞来计算，并以细胞百分比表示。
text_zh: 吞噬活性通过显微镜下计数200个吞噬细胞来计算，并以细胞百分比表示。
text_en: Phagocytic activity was calculated by counting 200 phagocytes under a microscope and expressed as the percentage of cells.

quote: The serum samples collected at 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 weeks were used for determining the lysozyme (LZY), acid phosphatase (ACP), alkaline phosphatase (AKP), superoxide dismutase (SOD), interleukin-1β (IL-1β), interleukin-10 (IL-10), and tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α) activity.
statement: 在2、4、6、8和10周采集的血清样本用于测定溶菌酶、酸性磷酸酶、碱性磷酸酶、超氧化物歧化酶、白细胞介素-1β、白细胞介素-10和肿瘤坏死因子-α的活性。
text_zh: 在2、4、6、8和10周采集的血清样本用于测定溶菌酶、酸性磷酸酶、碱性磷酸酶、超氧化物歧化酶、白细胞介素-1β、白细胞介素-10和肿瘤坏死因子-α的活性。
text_en: Serum samples collected at 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 weeks were used to determine the activity of lysozyme, acid phosphatase, alkaline phosphatase, superoxide dismutase, interleukin-1β, interleukin-10 and tumor necrosis factor-α.
intervention_record: 非特异性免疫参数测定

quote: Among the isolates, 60 out of 136 isolates exhibited antagonistic activity against the aquatic pathogens (A. veronii and A. hydrophila).
statement: 在分离出的菌株中，136株中有60株对水生病原菌（维氏气单胞菌和水解气单胞菌）表现出拮抗活性。
text_zh: 在分离出的菌株中，136株中有60株对水生病原菌（维氏气单胞菌和水解气单胞菌）表现出拮抗活性。
text_en: Among the isolated strains, 60 out of 136 showed antagonistic activity against aquatic pathogens (Aeromonas veronii and Aeromonas hydrophila).

quote: The bacteriocin-like activity of Bacillus isolates were determined by agar well-diffusion method and the results showed that four isolates display inhibitory activities against fish pathogenic bacteria, including A. caviae , A. salraonicida , E. coli , S. Typhimurium , S. choleraesuis , and P. hauseri , especially A. veronii, A. hydrophila (Supplementary Table S2).
statement: 通过琼脂孔扩散法测定芽孢杆菌分离株的类细菌素活性，结果显示四个分离株对包括豚鼠气单胞菌、沙门氏菌、大肠杆菌、伤寒沙门氏菌、猪霍乱沙门氏菌和豪瑟假单胞菌在内的鱼类致病菌具有抑制活性，尤其是对维氏气单胞菌和水解气单胞菌。
text_zh: 通过琼脂孔扩散法测定芽孢杆菌分离株的类细菌素活性，结果显示四个分离株对包括豚鼠气单胞菌、沙门氏菌、大肠杆菌、伤寒沙门氏菌、猪霍乱沙门氏菌和豪瑟假单胞菌在内的鱼类致病菌具有抑制活性，尤其是对维氏气单胞菌和水解气单胞菌。
text_en: Bacteriocin-like activity of Bacillus isolates was determined by agar well diffusion assay, and the results showed that four isolates had inhibitory activity against fish pathogens including Aeromonas caviae, Salmonella, Escherichia coli, Salmonella typhi, Salmonella choleraesuis, and Pseudomonas hauseri, especially against Aeromonas veronii and Aeromonas hydrophila.

quote: Antagonistic effects were also observed on 3 g-positive pathogens: S. aureus , S. agalactiae , and C. perfringens .
statement: 还观察到对三种革兰氏阳性病原体（金黄色葡萄球菌、无乳链球菌和产气荚膜梭菌）的拮抗作用。
text_zh: 还观察到对三种革兰氏阳性病原体（金黄色葡萄球菌、无乳链球菌和产气荚膜梭菌）的拮抗作用。
text_en: Antagonistic effects against three Gram-positive pathogens (Staphylococcus aureus, Streptococcus agalactiae, and Clostridium perfringens) were also observed.

quote: isms exert beneficial effects through controlling the balance of microbes in gut, enhancing growth performance and improving the ecosystem of gut microbiota have been considered as probiotics in aquaculture including Lactobacillus, Bacillus (Han et al., 2015 ; Kong et al., 2017), Enterococcus and Vibrio (Chen et al., 2015).
statement: 某些微生物通过控制肠道菌群平衡、提高生长性能和改善肠道微生态系统，在水产养殖中被视为益生菌。
text_zh: 某些微生物通过控制肠道菌群平衡、提高生长性能和改善肠道微生态系统，在水产养殖中被视为益生菌。
text_en: Some microorganisms are considered probiotics in aquaculture by controlling gut microbiota balance, improving growth performance, and enhancing the intestinal microecosystem.

quote: Confirmation that probiotic administration could be an effective alternative to chemical therapies or vaccination was elucidated in fish affected by Bacillus (Hong et al., 2005 ; Khochamit et al., 2015).
statement: 在受芽孢杆菌影响的鱼类中证实，施用益生菌可能是化学疗法或疫苗接种的有效替代方案。
text_zh: 在受芽孢杆菌影响的鱼类中证实，施用益生菌可能是化学疗法或疫苗接种的有效替代方案。
text_en: In fish affected by Bacillus, the administration of probiotics may be an effective alternative to chemotherapy or vaccination.

quote: Previous studies have demonstrated that Bacillus species such as Bacillus subtilis and Bacillus velezensis have been used as probiotics to control bacterial diseases in aquaculture since the species have capacity to produce versatile anti-microbial compounds as well as immune response promotion substance (Guo et al., 2016 ; Yi et al., 2018 ; Zaineldin et al., 2018).
statement: 先前的研究表明，枯草芽孢杆菌和贝莱斯芽孢杆菌等芽孢杆菌物种已被用作益生菌以控制水产养殖中的细菌性疾病，因为它们能够产生多种抗菌化合物以及促进免疫反应的物质。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，枯草芽孢杆菌和贝莱斯芽孢杆菌等芽孢杆菌物种已被用作益生菌以控制水产养殖中的细菌性疾病，因为它们能够产生多种抗菌化合物以及促进免疫反应的物质。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that Bacillus species such as Bacillus subtilis and Bacillus velezensis have been used as probiotics to control bacterial diseases in aquaculture, because they are able to produce various antimicrobial compounds and substances that promote immune responses.
outcome: 细菌性疾病控制与免疫调节

quote: Research in African catfish (Clarias gariepinus) model confirmed that Bacillus species are appropriate candidates for aquaculture as delivery vehicles improving growth performance, serum antioxidants, and immune parameters (Reda et al., 2018).
statement: 在非洲鲶鱼模型中的研究证实，芽孢杆菌物种是水产养殖中合适的候选载体，可改善生长性能、血清抗氧化剂和免疫参数。
text_zh: 在非洲鲶鱼模型中的研究证实，芽孢杆菌物种是水产养殖中合适的候选载体，可改善生长性能、血清抗氧化剂和免疫参数。
text_en: Studies in the African catfish model confirmed that Bacillus species are suitable candidate carriers in aquaculture, capable of improving growth performance, serum antioxidants, and immune parameters.
outcome: 生长性能、抗氧化能力与免疫参数

quote: Thus, some Bacillus strains could be developed as potential probiotic and biological control agents.
statement: 因此，一些芽孢杆菌菌株可以开发为潜在的益生菌和生物防治剂。
text_zh: 因此，一些芽孢杆菌菌株可以开发为潜在的益生菌和生物防治剂。
text_en: Therefore, some Bacillus strains can be developed as potential probiotics and biocontrol agents.

quote: Our results showed that Crucian carp fed with the diet containing B. velezensis C-11 and S-22 developed a strong immune response with significantly higher (P B. velezensis L-17 and S-14 groups.
statement: 饲喂含有B. velezensis C-11和S-22日粮的鲫鱼产生了强烈的免疫反应，且显著高于L-17和S-14组。
text_zh: 饲喂含有B. velezensis C-11和S-22日粮的鲫鱼产生了强烈的免疫反应，且显著高于L-17和S-14组。
text_en: Crucian carp fed diets containing B. velezensis C-11 and S-22 produced a strong immune response, which was significantly higher than that of the L-17 and S-14 groups.

quote: Moreover, B. velezensis spores appeared to show no toxicity and damage in fish, which could inhabit the gut of Crucian carp.
statement: 此外，B. velezensis孢子对鱼似乎没有毒性和损害，并且可以定植于鲫鱼的肠道中。
text_zh: 此外，B. velezensis孢子对鱼似乎没有毒性和损害，并且可以定植于鲫鱼的肠道中。
text_en: In addition, B. velezensis spores appear to be non-toxic and non-damaging to fish, and can colonize the gut of crucian carp.

quote: B. velezensis restrained up-regulation of pro-inflammation cytokines (IL-1β, IFN-γ, and TNF-α) mRNA levels in the intestine and head kidney at final stage of administration, and the expression of IL-10 was increased throughout the 10-week trial.
statement: 在给药末期，B. velezensis抑制了肠道和头肾中促炎细胞因子（IL-1β、IFN-γ和TNF-α）mRNA水平的上调，并且在整个10周的试验期间IL-10的表达增加。
text_zh: 在给药末期，B. velezensis抑制了肠道和头肾中促炎细胞因子（IL-1β、IFN-γ和TNF-α）mRNA水平的上调，并且在整个10周的试验期间IL-10的表达增加。
text_en: At the end of administration, B. velezensis inhibited the upregulation of pro-inflammatory cytokine (IL-1β, IFN-γ and TNF-α) mRNA levels in the intestine and head kidney, and increased IL-10 expression throughout the 10-week trial period.

quote: In contrast, numerous goblet cells and few inflammatory cells infiltrated the mucosa in the B. velezensis groups after challenge with A. veronii .
statement: 相比之下，在A. veronii攻毒后，B. velezensis组的黏膜中有大量杯状细胞和少量炎症细胞浸润。
text_zh: 相比之下，在A. veronii攻毒后，B. velezensis组的黏膜中有大量杯状细胞和少量炎症细胞浸润。
text_en: In contrast, after A. veronii challenge, the B. velezensis group had numerous goblet cells and a small amount of inflammatory cell infiltration in the mucosa.

quote: Compared with A. veronii group, B. velezensis could safeguard the integrity of intestinal villi.
statement: 与A. veronii组相比，B. velezensis能够保护肠绒毛的完整性。
text_zh: 与A. veronii组相比，B. velezensis能够保护肠绒毛的完整性。
text_en: Compared to the A. veronii group, B. velezensis was able to protect the integrity of intestinal villi.

quote: The highest post-challenge survival rate (75.0%) was recorded in B. velezensis C-11 group.
statement: 在B. velezensis C-11组中记录了最高的攻毒后存活率（75.0%）。
text_zh: 在B. velezensis C-11组中记录了最高的攻毒后存活率（75.0%）。
text_en: The highest post-challenge survival rate (75.0%) was recorded in the B. velezensis C-11 group.

quote: Administration of B. velezensis induced the enhancement of the intestinal innate immune response through reducing intestinal colonization by pathogens
statement: 施用B. velezensis通过减少病原体在肠道中的定植，诱导了肠道先天免疫反应的增强。
text_zh: 施用B. velezensis通过减少病原体在肠道中的定植，诱导了肠道先天免疫反应的增强。
text_en: Application of B. velezensis induced an enhanced intestinal innate immune response by reducing pathogen colonization in the gut.
outcome: 先天免疫与病原体定植

quote: In this study, we found that the potential probiotics B. velezensis C-11, S-22, L-17, and S-14 isolated from gut of healthy Crucian carp, displayed positive probiotic properties on antimicrobial activity against fish pathogens (A. veronii and A. hydrophila), resistance to gastrointestinal tract conditions and production of digestive enzyme (cellulase, amylase, and protease).
statement: 本研究发现，从健康鲫鱼肠道中分离出的潜在益生菌 B. velezensis C-11、S-22、L-17 和 S-14 表现出对鱼类病原体（维氏气单胞菌和水产气单胞菌）的抗菌活性、对胃肠道条件的耐受性以及产生消化酶（纤维素酶、淀粉酶和蛋白酶）等积极的益生菌特性。
text_zh: 本研究发现，从健康鲫鱼肠道中分离出的潜在益生菌 B. velezensis C-11、S-22、L-17 和 S-14 表现出对鱼类病原体（维氏气单胞菌和水产气单胞菌）的抗菌活性、对胃肠道条件的耐受性以及产生消化酶（纤维素酶、淀粉酶和蛋白酶）等积极的益生菌特性。
text_en: This study found that the potential probiotics B. velezensis C-11, S-22, L-17 and S-14 isolated from the intestines of healthy crucian carp exhibited positive probiotic characteristics such as antibacterial activity against fish pathogens (Aeromonas veronii and Aeromonas hydrophila), tolerance to gastrointestinal conditions, and production of digestive enzymes (cellulase, amylase and protease).

quote: Bacillus spp. isolated from healthy fish gastrointestinal tract have been widely employed as natural alternatives to antibiotics and chemical treatments for the control of diseases (Lee et al., 2016 ; Rauta et al., 2016 ; Meidong et al., 2017a).
statement: 从健康鱼胃肠道中分离出的芽孢杆菌属已被广泛用作控制疾病的抗生素和化学处理的天然替代品。
text_zh: 从健康鱼胃肠道中分离出的芽孢杆菌属已被广泛用作控制疾病的抗生素和化学处理的天然替代品。
text_en: Bacillus spp. isolated from the gastrointestinal tract of healthy fish have been widely used as natural alternatives to antibiotics and chemical treatments for disease control.

quote: Although inflammatory cells infiltrated the LP and mucosa was detected in the B. velezensis + A. veronii groups, intestinal villi were intact and a notable goblet cells accumulation as compared to A. veronii group (P Figure 9 and Supplementary Table S4).
statement: 与仅感染维氏气单胞菌的组相比，接种贝莱斯芽孢杆菌并感染维氏气单胞菌的组虽然仍有炎症细胞浸润，但肠绒毛保持完整且杯状细胞显著积累。
text_zh: 与仅感染维氏气单胞菌的组相比，接种贝莱斯芽孢杆菌并感染维氏气单胞菌的组虽然仍有炎症细胞浸润，但肠绒毛保持完整且杯状细胞显著积累。
text_en: Compared to the group infected only with Aeromonas veronii, the group orally immunized with Bacillus velezensis and infected with Aeromonas veronii still had inflammatory cell infiltration, but the intestinal villi remained intact and goblet cells accumulated significantly.
outcome: 肠道组织病理学（绒毛完整性、杯状细胞数量）

quote: Moreover, the length of the intestinal villi significantly decreased, and the width of intestinal villi increased in the A. veronii group (P Figures 9G,H).
statement: 在仅感染维氏气单胞菌的组中，肠绒毛长度显著缩短，宽度增加。
text_zh: 在仅感染维氏气单胞菌的组中，肠绒毛长度显著缩短，宽度增加。
text_en: In the group infected with Aeromonas veronii only, intestinal villus length was significantly shortened and width increased.
outcome: 肠道形态结构（绒毛长度和宽度）

quote: However, no significant difference in intestinal villi length and width was observed between control and B. velezensis + A. veronii groups (Supplementary Table S4).
statement: 对照组与接种贝莱斯芽孢杆菌并感染维氏气单胞菌的组之间，肠绒毛长度和宽度无显著差异。
text_zh: 对照组与接种贝莱斯芽孢杆菌并感染维氏气单胞菌的组之间，肠绒毛长度和宽度无显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference in intestinal villus length and width between the control group and the group orally immunized with Bacillus velezensis and infected with Aeromonas veronii.
outcome: 肠道形态结构（绒毛长度和宽度）

quote: A significant increase in the mortality of the control group (100%) was detected during the infection.
statement: 在感染期间，对照组的死亡率显著增加至100%。
text_zh: 在感染期间，对照组的死亡率显著增加至100%。
text_en: During the infection period, mortality in the control group increased significantly to 100%.

quote: Conversely, the survival rates in the fish orally immunized probiotic groups (75.0, 62.5, 60.0, 53.3%) were higher compared to the control group after 14 days post-infection (Figure 10).
statement: 与对照组相比，口服免疫益生菌的鱼组在感染后14天的存活率更高（分别为75.0%, 62.5%, 60.0%, 53.3%）。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，口服免疫益生菌的鱼组在感染后14天的存活率更高（分别为75.0%, 62.5%, 60.0%, 53.3%）。
text_en: Compared with the control group, fish groups orally immunized with probiotics had higher survival rates at 14 days post-infection (75.0%, 62.5%, 60.0%, and 53.3%, respectively).

quote: A higher IFN-γ expression was observed after 2 weeks of feeding (P Figures 8C,G).
statement: 喂养2周后观察到IFN-γ表达升高。
text_zh: 喂养2周后观察到IFN-γ表达升高。
text_en: Elevated IFN-γ expression was observed after 2 weeks of feeding.
outcome: 免疫基因表达（干扰素反应）

quote: down-regulation of TNF-α was observed in gut samples after 4 weeks of administration
statement: 给药四周后，肠道样本中观察到TNF-α的下调。
text_zh: 给药四周后，肠道样本中观察到TNF-α的下调。
text_en: Downregulation of TNF-α was observed in intestinal samples four weeks after administration.

quote: histological examination of the mid-intestine of Crucian carp fed the probiotic diet for 8 weeks demonstrated intestine inflammation injury was decreased after challenge with A. veronii
statement: 对饲喂益生菌饲料8周的鲫鱼进行组织学检查表明，在维氏气单胞菌攻击后，肠道炎症损伤减少。
text_zh: 对饲喂益生菌饲料8周的鲫鱼进行组织学检查表明，在维氏气单胞菌攻击后，肠道炎症损伤减少。
text_en: Histological examination of crucian carp fed probiotic feed for 8 weeks showed reduced intestinal inflammatory damage after Aeromonas veronii challenge.

quote: No clinical signs of abnormalities were observed for the isolates against experimental fish compared to control.
statement: 与对照组相比，未观察到分离株对实验鱼产生异常的临床症状。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，未观察到分离株对实验鱼产生异常的临床症状。
text_en: Compared with the control group, no abnormal clinical symptoms were observed in experimental fish inoculated with the isolate.

quote: In addition, no impact on the swimming behavior, body weight, and mortality was found (data not shown).
statement: 此外，未发现对游泳行为、体重和死亡率的影响。
text_zh: 此外，未发现对游泳行为、体重和死亡率的影响。
text_en: In addition, no effects on swimming behavior, body weight, and mortality were found.

quote: The histopathological analysis revealed that no damage was detected in the spleen, head kidney, liver, intestine, and heart of Crucian carp after oral administration with B. velezensis (Supplementary Figure S6).
statement: 组织病理学分析显示，口服B. velezensis后，鲫鱼脾脏、头肾、肝脏、肠道和心脏未检测到损伤。
text_zh: 组织病理学分析显示，口服B. velezensis后，鲫鱼脾脏、头肾、肝脏、肠道和心脏未检测到损伤。
text_en: Histopathological analysis showed that no damage was detected in the spleen, head kidney, liver, intestine and heart of crucian carp after oral administration of B. velezensis.

quote: At 2 weeks after feed-trials, phagocytic activities of PBLs and HKLs were not statistical significance between the B. velezensis supplemented and control groups (P > 0.05).
statement: 在饲料试验2周后，补充B. velezensis组与对照组的PBLs和HKLs吞噬活性无统计学显著差异。
text_zh: 在饲料试验2周后，补充B. velezensis组与对照组的PBLs和HKLs吞噬活性无统计学显著差异。
text_en: After 2 weeks of the feeding trial, there was no statistically significant difference in the phagocytic activity of PBLs and HKLs between the B. velezensis-supplemented group and the control group.

quote: After 4 weeks, the fish treated with the probiotics exhibited significantly higher (P Figure 4).
statement: 4周后，用益生菌处理的鱼表现出显著更高的[吞噬活性]。
text_zh: 4周后，用益生菌处理的鱼表现出显著更高的[吞噬活性]。
text_en: After 4 weeks, fish treated with probiotics showed significantly higher [phagocytic activity].

quote: Our data showed that the mRNA level of cytokine interleukin 1β (IL-1β) was up-regulated until 8 week, and B. velezensis restrained up-regulation of IL-1β in head kidney and intestine tissues after 8 week (Figures 8A,E) compared to the control group.
statement: 数据显示，与对照组相比，B. velezensis抑制了第8周后头肾和肠道组织中IL-1β的上调表达。
text_zh: 数据显示，与对照组相比，B. velezensis抑制了第8周后头肾和肠道组织中IL-1β的上调表达。
text_en: Data show that, compared with the control group, B. velezensis inhibited the upregulated expression of IL-1β in head kidney and intestinal tissues after week 8.
outcome: 免疫基因表达（炎症反应）

quote: The increased IL-10 transcripts were obtained in fish fed diets containing B. velezensis throughout the 10-week study period (P Figures 8B,F).
statement: 在整个10周的研究期间，喂食含B. velezensis饲料的鱼获得了增加的IL-10转录本。
text_zh: 在整个10周的研究期间，喂食含B. velezensis饲料的鱼获得了增加的IL-10转录本。
text_en: Throughout the 10-week study period, fish fed diets containing B. velezensis obtained increased IL-10 transcripts.
outcome: 免疫基因表达（抗炎反应）

quote: our study indicated that B. velezensis isolated from fish may influenced enzyme activities of gut microbiota.
statement: 本研究表明，从鱼中分离出的B. velezensis可能影响肠道微生物群的酶活性。
text_zh: 本研究表明，从鱼中分离出的B. velezensis可能影响肠道微生物群的酶活性。
text_en: This study shows that B. velezensis isolated from fish may affect the enzyme activity of the gut microbiota.

quote: These researches indicated that certain gut microbiota might be good candidates as probiotic to improve food utilization efficiency in aquaculture.
statement: 这些研究表明，某些肠道微生物群可能是改善水产养殖食物利用效率的良好益生菌候选者。
text_zh: 这些研究表明，某些肠道微生物群可能是改善水产养殖食物利用效率的良好益生菌候选者。
text_en: These studies suggest that certain gut microbiota may be good probiotic candidates for improving feed utilization efficiency in aquaculture.

quote: Similar to our study, B. subtilis isolated from the intestine of the grass carp as probiotic with tolerances to gastric and intestinal conditions (Guo et al., 2016).
statement: 与我们的研究类似，从草鱼肠道中分离出的枯草芽孢杆菌作为益生菌，具有对胃和肠道条件的耐受性。
text_zh: 与我们的研究类似，从草鱼肠道中分离出的枯草芽孢杆菌作为益生菌，具有对胃和肠道条件的耐受性。
text_en: Similar to our study, Bacillus subtilis isolated from the gut of grass carp as a probiotic has tolerance to gastric and intestinal conditions.

quote: Our data confirmed that the B. velezensis isolates were safe to Crucian carp.
statement: 数据证实了B. velezensis分离株对鲫鱼是安全的。
text_zh: 数据证实了B. velezensis分离株对鲫鱼是安全的。
text_en: Data confirmed that the B. velezensis isolate is safe for crucian carp.

quote: In addition, B. velezensis isolates are susceptible to most of the common antibiotics tested, which indicated that the isolates have inability to induce multidrug resistance and transfer antibiotic-resistant genes to organism of host gut.
statement: 此外，B. velezensis分离株对测试的大多数常见抗生素敏感，这表明这些分离株无法诱导多重耐药性或将抗生素抗性基因转移给宿主肠道生物。
text_zh: 此外，B. velezensis分离株对测试的大多数常见抗生素敏感，这表明这些分离株无法诱导多重耐药性或将抗生素抗性基因转移给宿主肠道生物。
text_en: In addition, B. velezensis isolates were sensitive to most of the common antibiotics tested, indicating that these isolates cannot induce multidrug resistance or transfer antibiotic resistance genes to host gut biota.

quote: In our experiments, the fish fed diets containing B. velezensis isolates showed significantly higher phagocytosis of PBLs and HKLs than the control fish after 8 weeks of administration (Figure 4).
statement: 在我们的实验中，喂食含有B. velezensis分离株饲料的鱼在给药8周后，其外周血白细胞(PBLs)和头肾白细胞(HKLs)的吞噬作用显著高于对照鱼。
text_zh: 在我们的实验中，喂食含有B. velezensis分离株饲料的鱼在给药8周后，其外周血白细胞(PBLs)和头肾白细胞(HKLs)的吞噬作用显著高于对照鱼。
text_en: In our experiment, fish fed feed containing a B. velezensis isolate showed significantly higher phagocytic activity of peripheral blood leukocytes (PBLs) and head kidney leukocytes (HKLs) after 8 weeks of administration compared to control fish.

quote: However, phagocytic activities of B cells were not statistical significance between the probiotic and control groups at week 2, it seems possible that the B. velezensis are modulating phagocytic cells a
statement: 然而，在第2周时，益生菌组和对照组之间B细胞的吞噬活性没有统计学显著性差异，这似乎表明B. velezensis可能正在调节吞噬细胞。
text_zh: 然而，在第2周时，益生菌组和对照组之间B细胞的吞噬活性没有统计学显著性差异，这似乎表明B. velezensis可能正在调节吞噬细胞。
text_en: However, at week 2, there was no statistically significant difference in the phagocytic activity of B cells between the probiotic group and the control group, which seems to indicate that B. velezensis may be modulating phagocytes.
counterevidence: 早期（第2周）未观察到B细胞吞噬活性的显著变化

quote: The fish from the probiotics treated groups and the control group were orally intubated with 200 μL of viable A. veronii (1 × 10 7 CFU/mL) per fish.
statement: 益生菌处理组和对照组的鱼每尾经口灌胃200 μL活性的维氏气单胞菌（1 × 10^7 CFU/mL）。
text_zh: 益生菌处理组和对照组的鱼每尾经口灌胃200 μL活性的维氏气单胞菌（1 × 10^7 CFU/mL）。
text_en: Fish in the probiotic treatment group and the control group were each orally gavaged with 200 μL of live Aeromonas veronii (1 × 10^7 CFU/mL).

quote: Fish orally intubated with 200 μL PBS were used as the blank control group.
statement: 经口灌胃200 μL PBS的鱼用作空白对照组。
text_zh: 经口灌胃200 μL PBS的鱼用作空白对照组。
text_en: Fish orally gavaged with 200 μL PBS were used as the blank control group.

quote: The daily mortality of the challenged fish was monitored for 2 weeks.
statement: 被攻击鱼的每日死亡率监测了2周。
text_zh: 被攻击鱼的每日死亡率监测了2周。
text_en: The daily mortality rate of attacked fish was monitored for 2 weeks.

quote: After challenge, the mid-intestinal tracts were fixed in 4% neutral formalin and embedded in paraffin for histopathological analysis.
statement: 攻击后，中肠段用4%中性福尔马林固定并包埋于石蜡中进行组织病理学分析。
text_zh: 攻击后，中肠段用4%中性福尔马林固定并包埋于石蜡中进行组织病理学分析。
text_en: After the challenge, the midgut segment was fixed in 4% neutral formalin and embedded in paraffin for histopathological analysis.

quote: Moreover, the number of inflammatory cells was calculated from six microscope vision of each fish and the data were converted to an area of 1 mm 2 .
statement: 此外，从每条鱼的六个显微镜视野计算炎症细胞数量，并将数据转换为1 mm²面积。
text_zh: 此外，从每条鱼的六个显微镜视野计算炎症细胞数量，并将数据转换为1 mm²面积。
text_en: In addition, the number of inflammatory cells was calculated from six microscopic fields per fish, and the data were converted to an area of 1 mm².

quote: it seems possible that the B. velezensis are modulating phagocytic cells activation by colonization, and this should be studied further.
statement: B. velezensis 可能通过定植调节吞噬细胞的激活，这需要进一步研究。
text_zh: B. velezensis 可能通过定植调节吞噬细胞的激活，这需要进一步研究。
text_en: B. velezensis may regulate phagocyte activation through colonization, which requires further study.

quote: in vivo studies have shown that pretreatment with probiotics can protect Crucian carp and Nile tilapia from A. hydrophila (Hamdan et al., 2016 ; Yi et al., 2018).
statement: 体内研究表明，益生菌预处理可以保护鲫鱼和尼罗罗非鱼免受嗜水气单胞菌感染。
text_zh: 体内研究表明，益生菌预处理可以保护鲫鱼和尼罗罗非鱼免受嗜水气单胞菌感染。
text_en: In vivo studies have shown that probiotic pretreatment can protect crucian carp and Nile tilapia from Aeromonas hydrophila infection.

quote: Park et al. (2010) demonstrated that B. subtilis secreting surfactin could regulate inflammatory response by reducing the expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines through interruption of signal pathway (nuclear factor-kappa B, NF-κB).
statement: Park等人(2010)证明分泌表面活性素的枯草芽孢杆菌可以通过中断信号通路(NF-κB)减少促炎细胞因子的表达来调节炎症反应。
text_zh: Park等人(2010)证明分泌表面活性素的枯草芽孢杆菌可以通过中断信号通路(NF-κB)减少促炎细胞因子的表达来调节炎症反应。
text_en: Park et al. (2010) demonstrated that surfactin-secreting Bacillus subtilis can modulate the inflammatory response by reducing the expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines through interrupting signaling pathways (NF-κB).
intervention_record: 分泌表面活性素的枯草芽孢杆菌

quote: Our results confirmed that B. velezensis isolates induced immune responses and the expression levels of immune-related genes (IL-1β, IFN-γ, and TNF-α) were up-regulated in gut and head kidney of Crucian carp at earlier stage of feeding (Figure 8).
statement: 结果证实，B. velezensis 分离株诱导了免疫反应，并且在喂食早期阶段，鲫鱼肠道和头肾中免疫相关基因(IL-1β, IFN-γ, TNF-α)的表达水平上调。
text_zh: 结果证实，B. velezensis 分离株诱导了免疫反应，并且在喂食早期阶段，鲫鱼肠道和头肾中免疫相关基因(IL-1β, IFN-γ, TNF-α)的表达水平上调。
text_en: The results confirmed that the B. velezensis isolate induced an immune response, and in the early feeding stage, the expression levels of immune-related genes (IL-1β, IFN-γ, TNF-α) were upregulated in the intestine and head kidney of crucian carp.

quote: Besides, the probiotics also increased the serum level of IL-1β, IL-10, and TNF-α in serum (Figure 6).
statement: 此外，益生菌还增加了血清中IL-1β、IL-10和TNF-α的水平。
text_zh: 此外，益生菌还增加了血清中IL-1β、IL-10和TNF-α的水平。
text_en: In addition, probiotics increased the levels of IL-1β, IL-10 and TNF-α in serum.

quote: We speculated that B. velezensis probiotics applied in this study may enhance the appropriate commensal bacterial colonization in gut, which might trigger activation of lymphocytes, macrophages and natural killer cells (NK cells) that release a variety of pro-inflammatory mediators.
statement: 作者推测本研究中使用的B. velezensis益生菌可能通过增强肠道共生菌定植，进而激活淋巴细胞、巨噬细胞和自然杀伤细胞释放促炎介质。
text_zh: 作者推测本研究中使用的B. velezensis益生菌可能通过增强肠道共生菌定植，进而激活淋巴细胞、巨噬细胞和自然杀伤细胞释放促炎介质。
text_en: The authors speculate that the B. velezensis probiotic used in this study may activate lymphocytes, macrophages, and natural killer cells to release pro-inflammatory mediators by enhancing the colonization of intestinal symbionts.

quote: At week 8, phagocytic activity (64.0%) of PBLs was enhanced significantly (P B. velezensis C-11 fed group in comparison to the control group (Figures 4A,B).
statement: Phagocytic activity of PBLs was significantly enhanced in the B. velezensis C-11 fed group compared to the control group at week 8.
text_en: Phagocytic activity of PBLs was significantly enhanced in the B. velezensis C-11 fed group compared to the control group at week 8.
intervention: Feeding specific Bacillus strains (C-11, S-22, S-14, L-17)

quote: Similar result was also observed in HKLs of fish treated with B. velezensis C-11 (60.1%) at week 8 (Figures 4C,D).
statement: A similar significant enhancement in phagocytic activity was observed in HKLs of fish treated with B. velezensis C-11 at week 8.
text_en: A similar significant enhancement in phagocytic activity was observed in HKLs of fish treated with B. velezensis C-11 at week 8.
intervention: Feeding specific Bacillus strains (C-11, S-22, S-14, L-17)

quote: During feed-trials period, the serum lysozyme activity of fish received B. velezensis C-11 had significantly (P Figure 5A).
statement: Serum lysozyme activity was significantly affected in fish receiving B. velezensis C-11 during the feed-trials period.
text_en: Serum lysozyme activity was significantly affected in fish receiving B. velezensis C-11 during the feed-trials period.
intervention: Feeding specific Bacillus strains (C-11, S-22, S-14, L-17)
outcome: 体液免疫参数（溶菌酶活性）

quote: A significantly increased ACP activity was observed in B. velezensis C-11 and S-22 groups as compared with control group after 4 weeks (P Figure 5B).
statement: ACP activity was significantly increased in B. velezensis C-11 and S-22 groups compared to the control group after 4 weeks.
text_en: ACP activity was significantly increased in B. velezensis C-11 and S-22 groups compared to the control group after 4 weeks.
intervention: Feeding specific Bacillus strains (C-11, S-22, S-14, L-17)

quote: Moreover, the levels of SOD activity in probiotic groups were significantly higher after second week of feeding (P Figure 5D), and the B. velezensis C-11 group had a higher SOD activity among all the probiotic groups (Figure 5D).
statement: SOD activity levels were significantly higher in probiotic groups after the second week of feeding, with the B. velezensis C-11 group showing the highest activity among probiotic groups.
text_en: SOD activity levels were significantly higher in probiotic groups after the second week of feeding, with the B. velezensis C-11 group showing the highest activity among probiotic groups.

quote: Among the measured cytokines in serum, IL-1β, IL-10, and TNF-α activity of fish treated with B. velezensis C-11 showed higher significant values (P Figure 6).
statement: The activity of cytokines IL-1β, IL-10, and TNF-α in serum showed significantly higher values in fish treated with B. velezensis C-11.
text_en: The activity of cytokines IL-1β, IL-10, and TNF-α in serum showed significantly higher values in fish treated with B. velezensis C-11.
intervention: Feeding specific Bacillus strains (C-11, S-22, S-14, L-17)

quote: Currently, the gut microbiota has been reported for other probiotics such as Bacillus spp. and lactic acid bacteria, which proposed to constitute an alternative treatment for antibiotics associated adverse effects in aquaculture (Kazun′ and Kazun′, 2013).
statement: 目前已有报道指出其他益生菌如芽孢杆菌属和乳酸菌的肠道菌群情况，这些益生菌被提议作为水产养殖中抗生素相关副作用的替代治疗方法。
text_zh: 目前已有报道指出其他益生菌如芽孢杆菌属和乳酸菌的肠道菌群情况，这些益生菌被提议作为水产养殖中抗生素相关副作用的替代治疗方法。
text_en: It has been reported that other probiotics such as Bacillus spp. and lactic acid bacteria affect the gut microbiota, and these probiotics have been proposed as alternative treatments for antibiotic-related side effects in aquaculture.

quote: This study revealed that B. velezensis C-11, S-22, L-17, and S-14 displayed strongly antagonistic activity against fish pathogens (A. veronii and A. hydrophila).
statement: 本研究表明，B. velezensis C-11、S-22、L-17和S-14菌株对鱼类病原体（A. veronii和A. hydrophila）表现出强烈的拮抗活性。
text_zh: 本研究表明，B. velezensis C-11、S-22、L-17和S-14菌株对鱼类病原体（A. veronii和A. hydrophila）表现出强烈的拮抗活性。
text_en: This study shows that B. velezensis strains C-11, S-22, L-17 and S-14 exhibit strong antagonistic activity against fish pathogens (A. veronii and A. hydrophila).

quote: Interestingly, 3 g-positive pathogens (S. aureus , S. agalactiae , and C. perfringens) also effectively inhibited by all strains of B. velezensis (Supplementary Table S2), indicating that antagonistic property of broad spectrum of Bacillus isolates could be applied against genera Aeromonas and Streptococcus in aquaculture.
statement: 所有B. velezensis菌株均能有效抑制三种革兰氏阳性病原体（金黄色葡萄球菌、无乳链球菌和产气荚膜梭菌），表明芽孢杆菌分离株的广谱拮抗特性可应用于水产养殖中对抗气单胞菌属和链球菌属。
text_zh: 所有B. velezensis菌株均能有效抑制三种革兰氏阳性病原体（金黄色葡萄球菌、无乳链球菌和产气荚膜梭菌），表明芽孢杆菌分离株的广谱拮抗特性可应用于水产养殖中对抗气单胞菌属和链球菌属。
text_en: All B. velezensis strains effectively inhibited three Gram-positive pathogens (Staphylococcus aureus, Streptococcus agalactiae, and Clostridium perfringens), indicating that the broad-spectrum antagonistic properties of Bacillus isolates can be applied in aquaculture against Aeromonas and Streptococcus.

quote: Meidong et al. (2017a) studied the disease resistance and probiotic effects of Bacillus siamensis isolated from pickled vegetables, their results demonstrated that strains exhibited a broad-spectrum antibacterial activity (A. hydrophila and S. agalactiae) and conferred significant benefit in reducing catfish mortality when challenged by A. hydrophila .
statement: Meidong等人(2017a)的研究显示，从腌菜中分离的泰国芽孢杆菌菌株表现出广谱抗菌活性，并在受到嗜水气单胞菌攻击时显著降低了鲶鱼的死亡率。
text_zh: Meidong等人(2017a)的研究显示，从腌菜中分离的泰国芽孢杆菌菌株表现出广谱抗菌活性，并在受到嗜水气单胞菌攻击时显著降低了鲶鱼的死亡率。
text_en: A study by Meidong et al. (2017a) showed that Bacillus thuringiensis strains isolated from pickled vegetables exhibited broad-spectrum antibacterial activity and significantly reduced the mortality of catfish when challenged with Aeromonas hydrophila.

quote: Our study highlighted the three main enzyme activities produced by Bacillus strains possible contribute to food digestion.
statement: 本研究强调了芽孢杆菌菌株产生的三种主要酶活性可能有助于食物消化。
text_zh: 本研究强调了芽孢杆菌菌株产生的三种主要酶活性可能有助于食物消化。
text_en: This study highlights that three major enzyme activities produced by Bacillus strains may contribute to food digestion.

quote: Similarly, the levels of IgM in samples of skin mucus in the B. velezensis S-22-treated group increased significantly at 10 week post-vaccination compared with B. velezensis L-17, C-11, and S-14 groups (P Figure 7C).
statement: 与B. velezensis L-17、C-11和S-14组相比，B. velezensis S-22处理组在接种后10周时皮肤黏液中的IgM水平显著增加。
text_zh: 与B. velezensis L-17、C-11和S-14组相比，B. velezensis S-22处理组在接种后10周时皮肤黏液中的IgM水平显著增加。
text_en: Compared to the B. velezensis L-17, C-11 and S-14 groups, IgM levels in skin mucus were significantly increased in the B. velezensis S-22 treatment group at 10 weeks post-injection.
intervention: Feeding specific Bacillus strains (C-11, S-22, S-14, L-17)

quote: Meanwhile, a slow increase of IgM level in the B. velezensis C-11 and S-14 groups occurred after 8 week post-administration (Figure 7C).
statement: 在给药后8周，B. velezensis C-11和S-14组的IgM水平缓慢增加。
text_zh: 在给药后8周，B. velezensis C-11和S-14组的IgM水平缓慢增加。
text_en: At 8 weeks after administration, IgM levels in the B. velezensis C-11 and S-14 groups increased slowly.
intervention: Feeding specific Bacillus strains (C-11, S-22, S-14, L-17)

quote: Our results demonstrated that IgM could be significantly triggered in serum, intestinal mucus and skin mucus of Crucian carp following administrated with B. velezensis diets.
statement: 饲喂贝莱斯芽孢杆菌后，鲫鱼血清、肠道黏液和皮肤黏液中的IgM显著升高。
text_zh: 饲喂贝莱斯芽孢杆菌后，鲫鱼血清、肠道黏液和皮肤黏液中的IgM显著升高。
text_en: After feeding with B. velezensis, IgM levels in the serum, intestinal mucus, and skin mucus of crucian carp increased significantly.

quote: In agreement with our results, one study in grass carp has confirmed that specific immune responses with higher levels of IgM in serum and mucus samples induced by engineered B. subtilis (Tang et al., 2017).
statement: 一项关于草鱼的研究证实，工程化枯草芽孢杆菌诱导了血清和黏液样本中更高水平的IgM特异性免疫反应。
text_zh: 一项关于草鱼的研究证实，工程化枯草芽孢杆菌诱导了血清和黏液样本中更高水平的IgM特异性免疫反应。
text_en: A study on grass carp confirmed that engineered B. subtilis induced higher levels of IgM-specific immune responses in serum and mucus samples.

quote: After 6 weeks, all the probiotic groups displayed higher activity of IL-1β, IL-10, and TNF-α compared with the control group (Figure 6).
statement: 6周后，所有益生菌组的IL-1β、IL-10和TNF-α活性均高于对照组。
text_zh: 6周后，所有益生菌组的IL-1β、IL-10和TNF-α活性均高于对照组。
text_en: After 6 weeks, IL-1β, IL-10 and TNF-α activities in all probiotic groups were higher than those in the control group.

quote: Significant higher levels of IgM were observed in serum, intestinal mucus and skin mucus samples in different B. velezensis groups since week 6, when compared with the control group (P Figure 7).
statement: 自第6周起，与对照组相比，不同枯草芽孢杆菌组的血清、肠道黏液和皮肤黏液样本中的IgM水平显著升高。
text_zh: 自第6周起，与对照组相比，不同枯草芽孢杆菌组的血清、肠道黏液和皮肤黏液样本中的IgM水平显著升高。
text_en: From week 6 onwards, compared with the control group, IgM levels in serum, intestinal mucus and skin mucus samples were significantly increased in different Bacillus subtilis groups.

quote: Levels of IgM in samples of serum, intestinal mucus, and skin mucus in probiotic groups kept rising till week 8, and maintained significantly high levels until 10 weeks (Figure 7).
statement: 益生菌组血清、肠道黏液和皮肤黏液样本中的IgM水平持续上升至第8周，并在第10周前保持显著高水平。
text_zh: 益生菌组血清、肠道黏液和皮肤黏液样本中的IgM水平持续上升至第8周，并在第10周前保持显著高水平。
text_en: IgM levels in serum, intestinal mucus, and skin mucus samples of the probiotic group continued to rise until week 8 and remained significantly high before week 10.

quote: Significant higher levels of IgM were observed in serum samples of groups of B. velezensis C-11 and L-17 at 10 week post-vaccination, when compared with B. velezensis S-22 and S-14 groups (P Figure 7A).
statement: 接种后第10周，枯草芽孢杆菌C-11组和L-17组血清样本中的IgM水平显著高于枯草芽孢杆菌S-22组和S-14组。
text_zh: 接种后第10周，枯草芽孢杆菌C-11组和L-17组血清样本中的IgM水平显著高于枯草芽孢杆菌S-22组和S-14组。
text_en: At 10 weeks post-vaccination, serum IgM levels in the Bacillus subtilis C-11 and L-17 groups were significantly higher than those in the Bacillus subtilis S-22 and S-14 groups.
intervention: Feeding specific Bacillus strains (C-11, S-22, S-14, L-17)

quote: However, the level of IgM in serum did not differ between B. velezensis S-22 and S-14 groups (P > 0.05, Figure 7A).
statement: 然而，枯草芽孢杆菌S-22组和S-14组之间的血清IgM水平没有差异。
text_zh: 然而，枯草芽孢杆菌S-22组和S-14组之间的血清IgM水平没有差异。
text_en: However, there was no difference in serum IgM levels between the Bacillus subtilis S-22 group and the S-14 group.
intervention: Feeding specific Bacillus strains (C-11, S-22, S-14, L-17)

quote: Levels of IgM in samples of intestinal mucus in B. velezensis S-22 and L-17 groups maintained significantly high levels throughout experiment compared to B. velezensis C-11 and S-14 groups (P Figure 7B) at 10 week post-feeding, whereas no statistical differences were observed between B. velezensis C-11 and S-14 groups.
statement: 饲喂后第10周，枯草芽孢杆菌S-22组和L-17组肠道黏液样本中的IgM水平在整个实验期间均显著高于枯草芽孢杆菌C-11组和S-14组，而C-11组和S-14组之间无统计学差异。
text_zh: 饲喂后第10周，枯草芽孢杆菌S-22组和L-17组肠道黏液样本中的IgM水平在整个实验期间均显著高于枯草芽孢杆菌C-11组和S-14组，而C-11组和S-14组之间无统计学差异。
text_en: At week 10 post-feeding, IgM levels in intestinal mucus samples of the Bacillus subtilis S-22 and L-17 groups were significantly higher than those of the Bacillus subtilis C-11 and S-14 groups throughout the entire experimental period, with no statistically significant difference between the C-11 and S-14 groups.
intervention: Feeding specific Bacillus strains (C-11, S-22, S-14, L-17)

quote: However, this study provides evidence for mechanism underlying damage to A. veronii infections by which probiotic bacteria found in fish could regulate the local mucosal immune response and systemic immune response.
statement: This study provides evidence that probiotic bacteria found in fish can regulate local mucosal and systemic immune responses against A. veronii infections.
text_en: This study provides evidence that probiotic bacteria found in fish can regulate local mucosal and systemic immune responses against A. veronii infections.

quote: Notably, we found the responsible agents to work by anti-microbial activity, demonstrating that pathogen exclusion in the intestine may work by inhibition of pathogen colonization.
statement: The responsible agents work through antimicrobial activity, suggesting that pathogen exclusion in the intestine occurs via inhibition of pathogen colonization.
text_en: The responsible agents work through antimicrobial activity, suggesting that pathogen exclusion in the intestine occurs via inhibition of pathogen colonization.

quote: Furthermore, our findings emphasize the importance of B. velezensis for immunomodulatory.
statement: The findings emphasize the importance of B. velezensis for immunomodulation.
text_en: The findings emphasize the importance of B. velezensis for immunomodulation.

quote: Our study suggests a valuable application regarding alternative strategies to replace antibiotics, and Bacillus -containing dietary could be used for safe A. veronii decolonization strategy.
statement: The study suggests that Bacillus-containing diets could serve as an alternative strategy to replace antibiotics for safe A. veronii decolonization.
text_en: The study suggests that Bacillus-containing diets could serve as an alternative strategy to replace antibiotics for safe A. veronii decolonization.
outcome: 抗生素替代与病原清除

quote: Mycotoxin, such as aflatoxin, exposure in fish causes growth inhibition, bioaccumulation, immunosuppression, and increased susceptibility to opportunistic pathogens
statement: 霉菌毒素（如黄曲霉毒素）暴露于鱼类会导致生长抑制、生物富集、免疫抑制以及对机会性病原体的易感性增加。
text_zh: 霉菌毒素（如黄曲霉毒素）暴露于鱼类会导致生长抑制、生物富集、免疫抑制以及对机会性病原体的易感性增加。
text_en: Exposure to mycotoxins (such as aflatoxin) in fish leads to growth inhibition, bioaccumulation, immunosuppression, and increased susceptibility to opportunistic pathogens.

quote: This research provides insight into the possibility that AFB1 may increase the susceptibility of C. gibelio to CyHV-2 infection, and thus amplify the viral outbreak to endanger ecological safety in aquatic environment.
statement: 该研究提示AFB1可能增加银鲫对CyHV-2感染的易感性，从而放大病毒爆发并危及水生环境的生态安全。
text_zh: 该研究提示AFB1可能增加银鲫对CyHV-2感染的易感性，从而放大病毒爆发并危及水生环境的生态安全。
text_en: The study suggests that AFB1 may increase the susceptibility of gibel carp to CyHV-2 infection, thereby amplifying viral outbreaks and endangering the ecological safety of the aquatic environment.

quote: The fish were randomly selected and divided into three groups: Group 1 (control diet, C), Group 2 (control diet + 50 µg/kg AFB1, T1), and Group 3 (control diet + 100 µg/kg AFB1, T2).
statement: 鱼类被随机分为三组：对照组（基础日粮）、T1组（基础日粮+50 µg/kg AFB1）和T2组（基础日粮+100 µg/kg AFB1）。
text_zh: 鱼类被随机分为三组：对照组（基础日粮）、T1组（基础日粮+50 µg/kg AFB1）和T2组（基础日粮+100 µg/kg AFB1）。
text_en: Fish were randomly divided into three groups: a control group (basal diet), a T1 group (basal diet + 50 µg/kg AFB1), and a T2 group (basal diet + 100 µg/kg AFB1).

quote: On days 14 and 28 of feeding, three fish from each tank were randomly collected and anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS222 (Sigma Aldrich, St. Louis, MI, USA).
statement: 在饲喂第14天和第28天，从每个水箱中随机采集三条鱼，并使用100 mg/L的MS222进行麻醉。
text_zh: 在饲喂第14天和第28天，从每个水箱中随机采集三条鱼，并使用100 mg/L的MS222进行麻醉。
text_en: On days 14 and 28 of feeding, three fish were randomly collected from each tank and anesthetized using 100 mg/L MS222.

quote: Over the 28-day period, excluding sampled fish, the survival rate of the control, T1, and T2 fish was 98.8%, 97.2%, and 95.6%, respectively.
statement: 在28天的试验期间，排除采样鱼后，对照组、T1组和T2组的存活率分别为98.8%、97.2%和95.6%。
text_zh: 在28天的试验期间，排除采样鱼后，对照组、T1组和T2组的存活率分别为98.8%、97.2%和95.6%。
text_en: During the 28-day trial period, after excluding sampled fish, the survival rates of the control group, T1 group, and T2 group were 98.8%, 97.2%, and 95.6%, respectively.
counterevidence: 高剂量AFB1组存活率低于对照组

quote: The plasma lysozyme, ACP, AKP, and SOD concentration are considered as innate immune parameters following dietary supplementation of probiotics (Magnadóttir, 2006).
statement: 血浆溶菌酶、ACP、AKP和SOD浓度被认为是益生菌膳食补充后的先天免疫参数。
text_zh: 血浆溶菌酶、ACP、AKP和SOD浓度被认为是益生菌膳食补充后的先天免疫参数。
text_en: Plasma lysozyme, ACP, AKP and SOD concentrations are considered innate immune parameters after dietary probiotic supplementation.

quote: P Timothy and Dibyendu (2015) reported that catla (Catla catla) fed with B. subtilis supplemented diets showed higher levels of lysozyme and AKP compared to the control group.
statement: 据报道，喂食枯草芽孢杆菌补充饲料的卡特拉鱼（Catla catla）与对照组相比，显示更高的溶菌酶和AKP水平。
text_zh: 据报道，喂食枯草芽孢杆菌补充饲料的卡特拉鱼（Catla catla）与对照组相比，显示更高的溶菌酶和AKP水平。
text_en: It is reported that Catla catla fed with Bacillus subtilis supplemented feed showed higher lysozyme and AKP levels compared to the control group.

quote: By contrast, the serum lysozyme activity of tilapia treated with Bacillus strains showed no difference among the treatment groups after 40 days trial (Zhou et al., 2010).
statement: 相比之下，经过芽孢杆菌菌株处理的罗非鱼在40天试验后，各组间的血清溶菌酶活性没有差异。
text_zh: 相比之下，经过芽孢杆菌菌株处理的罗非鱼在40天试验后，各组间的血清溶菌酶活性没有差异。
text_en: In contrast, tilapia treated with Bacillus strains showed no difference in serum lysozyme activity between groups after a 40-day trial.

quote: the probiotics used in this study provoked significant phagocytic activities in the PBLs and HKLs.
statement: 本研究中使用的益生菌在外周血淋巴细胞（PBLs）和头肾淋巴细胞（HKLs）中引发了显著的吞噬活性。
text_zh: 本研究中使用的益生菌在外周血淋巴细胞（PBLs）和头肾淋巴细胞（HKLs）中引发了显著的吞噬活性。
text_en: The probiotics used in this study induced significant phagocytic activity in peripheral blood lymphocytes (PBLs) and head kidney lymphocytes (HKLs).

quote: The oxidative-antioxidant balance suggested that AFB1 induced severe oxidative stress, including increased reactive oxygen species (ROS) and malondialdehyde (MDA) levels in the AFB1 exposed group, and the reduced activity of superoxide dismutase (SOD), glutathione-S-transferase (GST) and catalase (CAT) in the AFB1 exposed group.
statement: 氧化-抗氧化平衡表明，黄曲霉毒素B1诱导了严重的氧化应激，包括暴露组中活性氧（ROS）和丙二醛（MDA）水平升高，以及超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、谷胱甘肽-S-转移酶（GST）和过氧化氢酶（CAT）活性降低。
text_zh: 氧化-抗氧化平衡表明，黄曲霉毒素B1诱导了严重的氧化应激，包括暴露组中活性氧（ROS）和丙二醛（MDA）水平升高，以及超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、谷胱甘肽-S-转移酶（GST）和过氧化氢酶（CAT）活性降低。
text_en: The oxidation-antioxidant balance indicates that aflatoxin B1 induced severe oxidative stress, including increased levels of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and malondialdehyde (MDA) in the exposure group, and decreased activities of superoxide dismutase (SOD), glutathione-S-transferase (GST), and catalase (CAT).

quote: Meanwhile, the related expression of nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2), interferon regulatory factor 3 (IRF3) and the type 1 interferon (IFN1) were noticeably down-regulated, but caspase-1 was up-regulated, after exposure to AFB1, demonstrating that fish are unable to avoid the virus infection.
statement: 同时，暴露于黄曲霉毒素B1后，核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）、干扰素调节因子3（IRF3）和I型干扰素（IFN1）的相关表达明显下调，但caspase-1上调，表明鱼类无法避免病毒感染。
text_zh: 同时，暴露于黄曲霉毒素B1后，核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）、干扰素调节因子3（IRF3）和I型干扰素（IFN1）的相关表达明显下调，但caspase-1上调，表明鱼类无法避免病毒感染。
text_en: At the same time, after exposure to aflatoxin B1, the relevant expression of nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2), interferon regulatory factor 3 (IRF3) and type I interferon (IFN1) was significantly downregulated, but caspase-1 was upregulated, indicating that fish cannot avoid viral infection.
outcome: 免疫基因表达与抗病毒能力

quote: It should be noted that the intestinal microbiota diversity and richness were lower in the AFB1 exposed group, and the composition of intestinal microbiota was affected by AFB1, resulting in the higher abundance of bacteria (such as Aeromonas and Bacteroides) and the lower abundance of potentially beneficial bacteria (such as Cetobacterium and Clostridium) in the AFB1 exposed group.
statement: 值得注意的是，黄曲霉毒素B1暴露组的肠道菌群多样性和丰富度较低，且肠道菌群组成受黄曲霉毒素B1影响，导致暴露组中某些细菌（如气单胞菌属和拟杆菌属）丰度较高，而潜在有益菌（如鲸杆菌属和梭菌属）丰度较低。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，黄曲霉毒素B1暴露组的肠道菌群多样性和丰富度较低，且肠道菌群组成受黄曲霉毒素B1影响，导致暴露组中某些细菌（如气单胞菌属和拟杆菌属）丰度较高，而潜在有益菌（如鲸杆菌属和梭菌属）丰度较低。
text_en: It is noteworthy that the aflatoxin B1 exposure group had lower gut microbiota diversity and richness, and the gut microbiota composition was affected by aflatoxin B1, resulting in higher abundance of certain bacteria (such as Aeromonas and Bacteroides) and lower abundance of potentially beneficial bacteria (such as Cetobacterium and Clostridium) in the exposed group.

quote: The previous study demonstrated that AFB1 induced excessive production of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and hydrogen peroxide (H 2 O 2) in the liver, and caused oxidative stress to aggravate liver damage
statement: 先前的研究表明，黄曲霉毒素B1（AFB1）诱导肝脏中活性氧（ROS）和过氧化氢（H2O2）的过量产生，并引起氧化应激以加重肝损伤。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，黄曲霉毒素B1（AFB1）诱导肝脏中活性氧（ROS）和过氧化氢（H2O2）的过量产生，并引起氧化应激以加重肝损伤。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that aflatoxin B1 (AFB1) induces excessive production of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) in the liver, and causes oxidative stress to aggravate liver damage.

quote: Therefore, the immune organ damage caused by AFB1 may be related to the reduction of the antioxidant capacity
statement: 因此，AFB1引起的免疫器官损伤可能与抗氧化能力的降低有关。
text_zh: 因此，AFB1引起的免疫器官损伤可能与抗氧化能力的降低有关。
text_en: Therefore, the immune organ damage caused by AFB1 may be related to a decrease in antioxidant capacity.
outcome: 免疫器官损伤与抗氧化能力

quote: However, research on the effects of aflatoxin on the intestinal flora in aquatic animals is lacking.
statement: 然而，关于黄曲霉毒素对水生动物肠道菌群影响的研究尚缺乏。
text_zh: 然而，关于黄曲霉毒素对水生动物肠道菌群影响的研究尚缺乏。
text_en: However, research on the effects of aflatoxin on the gut microbiota of aquatic animals is still lacking.

quote: Crucian carp hematopoietic necrosis is an acute and contagious hemorrhagic disease in crucian carp caused by cyprinid herpesvirus 2 (CyHV-2)
statement: 鲫鱼造血坏死是由鲤疱疹病毒2型（CyHV-2）引起的鲫鱼急性传染性出血性疾病。
text_zh: 鲫鱼造血坏死是由鲤疱疹病毒2型（CyHV-2）引起的鲫鱼急性传染性出血性疾病。
text_en: Crucian carp hematopoietic necrosis is an acute infectious hemorrhagic disease of crucian carp caused by Cyprinid herpesvirus 2 (CyHV-2).

quote: Research verified that supplementation Lactobacillus rhamnosus could effectively promote intestinal health by increasing the population of intraepithelial lymphocytes and the villous height in tilapia model (Pirarat et al., 2011 ; Sewaka et al., 2019).
statement: 研究证实，补充鼠李糖乳杆菌可通过增加罗非鱼模型中的上皮内淋巴细胞数量和绒毛高度来有效促进肠道健康。
text_zh: 研究证实，补充鼠李糖乳杆菌可通过增加罗非鱼模型中的上皮内淋巴细胞数量和绒毛高度来有效促进肠道健康。
text_en: Research has confirmed that supplementation with Lactobacillus rhamnosus can effectively promote intestinal health by increasing the number of intraepithelial lymphocytes and villus height in a tilapia model.

quote: The intestinal tract have been considered the primary probiotics colonization site, there is increasing evidence that diseases prevented and controlled using probiotics in aquaculture (Saputra et al., 2016).
statement: 肠道被认为是益生菌的主要定植部位，且有越来越多的证据表明在水产养殖中使用益生菌可以预防和控制疾病。
text_zh: 肠道被认为是益生菌的主要定植部位，且有越来越多的证据表明在水产养殖中使用益生菌可以预防和控制疾病。
text_en: The gut is considered the main colonization site for probiotics, and there is increasing evidence that the use of probiotics in aquaculture can prevent and control diseases.

quote: Dietary administration of B. velezensis for 8 weeks yielded significantly higher survival rates compared to the control group challenged by A. veronii (Figure 10).
statement: 饲喂贝莱斯芽孢杆菌8周后，与受维氏气单胞菌攻击的对照组相比，存活率显著更高。
text_zh: 饲喂贝莱斯芽孢杆菌8周后，与受维氏气单胞菌攻击的对照组相比，存活率显著更高。
text_en: After 8 weeks of feeding with B. velezensis, the survival rate was significantly higher compared to the control group challenged with A. veronii.

quote: B. amyloliquefaciens supplemented-diet showed protection against A. hydrophila in Nile tilapia (Saputra et al., 2016), in line with our observations with in vivo probiotic administration.
statement: 解淀粉芽孢杆菌补充饲料在尼罗罗非鱼中显示出对嗜水气单胞菌的保护作用，这与我们在体内益生菌给药中的观察结果一致。
text_zh: 解淀粉芽孢杆菌补充饲料在尼罗罗非鱼中显示出对嗜水气单胞菌的保护作用，这与我们在体内益生菌给药中的观察结果一致。
text_en: B. amyloliquefaciens supplemented-diet showed protective effects against Aeromonas hydrophila in Nile tilapia, which is consistent with our observations on in vivo probiotic administration.

quote: Similar results were observed in L. rohita treated with L. plantarum supplemented-diets and infected with A. hydrophila (Giri et al., 2013).
statement: 在感染嗜水气单胞菌并喂食植物乳杆菌补充饲料的露斯塔野鲮中也观察到了类似的结果。
text_zh: 在感染嗜水气单胞菌并喂食植物乳杆菌补充饲料的露斯塔野鲮中也观察到了类似的结果。
text_en: Similar results were also observed in Labeo rohita infected with Aeromonas hydrophila and fed diets supplemented with L. plantarum.

quote: Synthesis of mammals, fish and in vitro data points to an antagonistic activity of probiotics species, potentially mediated by their previously produced anti-microbial substance (Caballero et al., 2017).
statement: 综合哺乳动物、鱼类和体外数据表明，益生菌物种具有拮抗活性，这可能由其先前产生的抗菌物质介导。
text_zh: 综合哺乳动物、鱼类和体外数据表明，益生菌物种具有拮抗活性，这可能由其先前产生的抗菌物质介导。
text_en: Integrated data from mammals, fish, and in vitro studies indicate that probiotic species have antagonistic activity, which may be mediated by antimicrobial substances previously produced by them.

quote: It appears likely that live probiotic obtained with animals could reduce intestinal colonization by pathogens, and susceptibility to infection, such interference may be reached by blocking a signaling system of pathogen.
statement: 从动物身上获得的活益生菌似乎可能减少病原体在肠道的定植和对感染的易感性，这种干扰可能通过阻断病原体的信号系统来实现。
text_zh: 从动物身上获得的活益生菌似乎可能减少病原体在肠道的定植和对感染的易感性，这种干扰可能通过阻断病原体的信号系统来实现。
text_en: Live probiotics obtained from animals appear to possibly reduce pathogen colonization in the gut and susceptibility to infection; this interference may be achieved by blocking the signaling systems of pathogens.

quote: Scientific evidence to support the statements that probiotic improve disease resistance and health in fish is scarce.
statement: 支持益生菌改善鱼类抗病力和健康的科学证据很少。
text_zh: 支持益生菌改善鱼类抗病力和健康的科学证据很少。
text_en: There is little scientific evidence supporting the use of probiotics to improve disease resistance and health in fish.

quote: After 28 days of the feeding trial, a challenge test was performed in each group with CyHV-2 purified by sucrose gradient ultracentrifugation in our laboratory.
statement: 在28天喂养试验后，对每组进行使用实验室纯化的CyHV-2进行的攻毒试验。
text_zh: 在28天喂养试验后，对每组进行使用实验室纯化的CyHV-2进行的攻毒试验。
text_en: After a 28-day feeding trial, each group was subjected to a challenge test using laboratory-purified CyHV-2.
outcome: 疾病挑战与健康状态评估

quote: Fish in each group were intraperitoneally injected with 0.2 mL CyHV-2 (10 6.3 TCID 50 /mL).
statement: 每组鱼腹腔注射0.2毫升CyHV-2（10^6.3 TCID50/毫升）。
text_zh: 每组鱼腹腔注射0.2毫升CyHV-2（10^6.3 TCID50/毫升）。
text_en: Each group of fish was intraperitoneally injected with 0.2 mL of CyHV-2 (10^6.3 TCID50/mL).

quote: Infected fish were observed daily, and mortality was recorded for 14 days.
statement: 每天观察受感染的鱼，并记录14天的死亡率。
text_zh: 每天观察受感染的鱼，并记录14天的死亡率。
text_en: Infected fish were observed daily, and mortality was recorded for 14 days.

quote: The GST and CAT mRNA expression levels in the liver were significantly lower in the 50 μg/kg AFB1 and 100 μg/kg AFB1 exposed groups than in the control group on days 14 and 28
statement: 在暴露于黄曲霉毒素B1的第14天和第28天，肝脏中GST和CAT的mRNA表达水平显著低于对照组。
text_zh: 在暴露于黄曲霉毒素B1的第14天和第28天，肝脏中GST和CAT的mRNA表达水平显著低于对照组。
text_en: On day 14 and day 28 of exposure to aflatoxin B1, the mRNA expression levels of GST and CAT in the liver were significantly lower than those in the control group.

quote: The mRNA expressions of Nrf2, IRF3, and IFN1 were significantly lower in the AFB1 exposed groups on day 28
statement: 在第28天，AFB1暴露组的Nrf2、IRF3和IFN1的mRNA表达显著降低。
text_zh: 在第28天，AFB1暴露组的Nrf2、IRF3和IFN1的mRNA表达显著降低。
text_en: On day 28, mRNA expression of Nrf2, IRF3 and IFN1 was significantly decreased in the AFB1 exposure group.
outcome: 免疫及应激相关基因表达

quote: at day 28, the mRNA expressions of apoptosis related gene (Caspase-1) were significantly higher in the AFB1 treatment groups than in the control group
statement: 在第28天，AFB1处理组中与细胞凋亡相关的基因（Caspase-1）的mRNA表达显著高于对照组。
text_zh: 在第28天，AFB1处理组中与细胞凋亡相关的基因（Caspase-1）的mRNA表达显著高于对照组。
text_en: On day 28, the mRNA expression of the apoptosis-related gene (Caspase-1) in the AFB1-treated group was significantly higher than that in the control group.
